about: Flowy is an online flower brand founded in 2020, with a deep passion for flowers and a vision to transform the industry, Flowy is committed to delivering the freshest blooms, sourced from eco-friendly and sustainable farms, directly to customers nationwide. Unlike traditional models, Flowy streamlines the supply chain by connecting farms directly with consumers, ensuring longer-lasting freshness and better value. With a mission to spread the beauty of nature in a sustainable way, Flowy doesn’t just sell flowers—it delivers heartfelt stories, emotions, and sincerity in every bouquet.
industries: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage

updates.text: 🌸 Welcome to Flowy – Where Flowers Tell a Story 🌸 At Flowy, flowers are more than just beautiful blooms – they are emotions, memories, and moments captured in nature’s most delicate form. Every petal, every color, every scent has a meaning, and we’re here to help you express it. 💐✨ With five unique concepts, Flowy brings flowers to life in different ways: 🌿 Flowy by Nature – Celebrating fresh, natural blooms grown with care, free from harsh chemicals. ❤️ Flowy by Love – Expressing emotions through thoughtfully curated floral arrangements. 🎨 Flowy by Art – Transforming flowers into creative masterpieces that inspire and delight. 🙌 Flowy by Hand – Crafted with precision, passion, and a personal touch in every bouquet. 🌟 Flowy by You – A space for you to create and customize your own floral story. Whether it’s a special occasion, a heartfelt gift, or simply a way to brighten your day, Flowy is here to bring you the perfect flowers for every moment. Join us as we explore the art, love, and beauty of flowers together! 🌷💖 #WelcomeToFlowy #FlowerStories #BloomsWithMeaning #FloralArt #HandmadeWithLove #YourFlowersYourWay

With a mission to spread the beauty of nature in a sustainable way, Flowy doesn’t just sell flowers—it delivers heartfelt stories, emotions, and sincerity in every bouquet.

updates.text: ここ数年、日本企業は「デジタルトランスフォーメーション（DX）」を、高齢化社会、人材不足、そして激化するグローバル競争の中で生き残るための鍵として語り続けてきました。誰もが、プロセスを効率化し、生産性を向上させるためにDXが必要だと認識しています。 しかし、情報処理推進機構（IPA）の調査は厳しい現実を示しています。多くの日本企業はDXを単なるコスト削減の手段とみなし、結果として達成できているのは運用予算の節約にとどまっているのです。 詳細はこちらの記事でご紹介しています。 #ExtremeVietnam #ITConsulting #ITService #DX

updates.text: オフショアリング：別の視点から見直す時が来た 過去の事例が示すように、コスト削減だけを目的としたアウトソーシングは、訴訟・ブランド価値の低下・従業員の信頼喪失といったリスクを招きます。 今、日本企業に求められているのは「人を中心に据えたオフショアリング」です。 オフショアチームを「安価な労働力」としてではなく、自社組織の拡張として位置づけ、厳選採用・十分な研修・キャリア発展・公平な待遇を実現することが、持続的成長への鍵となります。 人材不足とコスト圧力が強まる中、オフショアリングをいかに「人の戦略」として捉えるかが、日本企業の未来を左右するでしょう。 👉 皆さんのご意見はいかがでしょうか？ぜひコメントでお聞かせください。

updates.text: AIと新技術：2025年からの日本企業における二重の解決策 日本企業は現在、二つの主要な潮流に直面しております。第一に、労働力不足を補うためにAIを活用する動き、第二に、新技術を通じて製品を革新する流れでございます。ロイターの調査によりますと、日本企業の60％が労働力不足に対応するためにAIを導入しており、53％の企業は労働コストの削減を目指しております。同時に、業界レポートでは世界的なソフトウェア開発需要の急増が予測されております。2025年までに不足するソフトウェアエンジニアは約400万人に達すると見込まれており、Web、モバイル、AI、ブロックチェーン分野における人材需要の高さを反映しております。製品革新の観点では、これらの技術が今後も拡大すると予測されており、EYの報告によれば、AIとWeb3の融合は個別の導入を上回る成果をもたらす可能性があるとされ、日本企業に新しい製品開発の道を開くものと考えられております。 1. 労働力不足を補うAIの活用 テクノロジー企業の場合： AIはエンジニアの代替ではなく、技術力を補完・拡張するツールとして位置づけられております。これにより、生産性の向上やプロセス改善が期待できます。代表的な応用例として、Jenkins、CircleCI、GitLab CIといったCI/CDプロセスにおけるソフトウェアテストの自動化、コード提案や最適化を行うAIプログラミングアシスタントが挙げられます。これらは製品開発サイクルの短縮に寄与いたします。インフラ、DevOps、機械学習の専門家不足に直面する中で、IT企業は中核人材への投資とオフショア協力を組み合わせ、革新のスピードを維持しつつ技術資産を保護する取り組みを進めております。 非テクノロジー企業の場合： AIは主に反復作業の自動化に利用されており、社員の手作業負担軽減に貢献しております。例えば、製造業におけるセンサー・データ分析による予知保全、小売業における消費需要分析を通じた在庫やマーケティング戦略の最適化、金融業における文書処理と分析の自動化による精度向上と時間短縮などがございます。効果的なアプローチは、社内ITチームと外部パートナーを組み合わせ、具体的なタスクごとに導入する方法であり、費用対効果を確保しやすいと考えられております。 2. AI＋Web3/ブロックチェーンによる製品イノベーション テクノロジー企業の場合： AIとブロックチェーン、Web3を組み合わせることで、検証済みデータを用いたAIモデルの学習や調整、スマートマーケットプレイスやトークン化サービスの開発など、新しいサービス創出の機会が広がっております。これらは製品ロードマップに組み込み、社内R&Dと国際的な協力を組み合わせて迅速な実証実験と成功事例の拡大を図ることが求められております。 非テクノロジー企業の場合： 革新は実用性を重視すべきであり、既存サービスの価値向上に重点を置いております。例えば、AIによる顧客体験の改善や、ブロックチェーンによるサプライチェーンの透明性向上が挙げられます。このような取り組みにより、大規模なR&D投資を行わずに運営効率を高め、顧客満足度を強化することが可能でございます。 結論 以上の二つの潮流に直面する日本企業の経営層は、単なる認識にとどまらず、迅速に行動計画へと落とし込む必要がございます。そのためには、リソースの適切な配分を優先し、特にAIとオフショア協力を組み合わせて人材問題に即応すること、さらにAIとWeb3の統合的応用を試験導入して製品革新の道を開くことが重要でございます。加えて、適切なテクノロジーパートナーの選定と明確な導入ロードマップの策定が、成功のスピードと確度を左右する鍵となると考えられております。 #Extremevn #EXV #ITConsulting #ITService

updates.text: AI ― デジタル時代における日本企業経営の最大の課題 日本企業の経営を担う立場から見ると、AIは大きなチャンスであると同時に、無数の懸念を抱えた存在でもあります。経営会議、役員会議、あるいはパートナーとの打ち合わせの場では常にAIの話題が取り上げられます。「AIは生産性やイノベーションを高める」と言われる一方で、必ず「リスクへの備えはできているのか」という問いが付随します。 これらの懸念は非常に現実的です。AIによるセキュリティの不具合は、ブランドの信用を失墜させ、法的な深刻な影響をもたらす可能性さえあります。 Bearing Pointの2025年調査によると、世界の経営層の73％がAI導入に際し「セキュリティとプライバシー」を最優先課題としています。日本においても、63％の企業が「AI戦略の進展が遅れている」と答え、58％が「導入の遅れによる競争力喪失」を懸念しています。一方、自社のデータがAIに対して十分安全だと自信を持つ企業は16％にとどまり、12％はコンプライアンス面に不安を抱えています。これは、多くの企業がインフラやデータポリシーにおいてまだ準備不足であることを示しています。これこそが、日本のCレベル経営者が直面している大きな課題です。 特に注目すべきAIリスク 1. 誤情報生成（Hallucination）：AIはもっともらしく聞こえるが完全に虚偽の内容を生成する可能性があります。適切な監査がなければ誤った経営判断につながりかねません。 2. 著作権侵害：AIの学習データはインターネット由来であることが多く、生成された内容が意図せず著作権作品を再利用する恐れがあります。厳格な著作権チェックが求められます。 3. 機密データ漏洩：従業員がAIに入力した情報は第三者に流出する危険性があります。特に顧客情報や戦略データの場合、影響は深刻です。 4. 信頼とコンプライアンスの喪失：データ事故や規制違反は企業の信用を傷つけ、法的処罰の対象となり、株主や顧客の信頼を失う結果につながります。 日本のCレベルに求められる方向性 こうしたリスクに立ち向かうには、単に技術を導入するだけでなく、包括的な予防策フレームワークが必要です。 1. 監査と検証：人間の監督なしにAIに意思決定を任せない。 2. AI倫理ポリシー：経営層がデータ利用範囲や違反時の処理について明確なルールを策定する。 3. レビュー体制：AI Ethics委員会を設置し、導入前にすべてのソリューションを精査する。 4. データセキュリティ：AIに投入するデータを明確化し、暗号化やアクセス制御を徹底する。 専門家たちは、AIの導入にあたり、従来のガバナンスの仕組みそのものを見直す必要があると指摘しています。 MIT Sloan Management Review（2025）も、安全にAIを活用するには「学際的な専門チームの設置」と「厳格な原則の策定」が不可欠だと強調しています。 このチームは、AIを利用できる領域とリスクが高すぎて利用すべきでない領域を明確に線引きし、その上で従業員に適切な利用方法を教育します。 つまり、経営層はAIに全てを任せて放置するのではなく、サイバーセキュリティと同様に明確な管理体制を整え、その枠組みの中でAIを活用していく必要があるのです。 最終的に決め手となるのは人間 この領域で決定的に重要なのは「人」です。人材育成は単なるAIの技術習得にとどまらず、「責任あるAI利用」という意識の醸成が不可欠です。従業員はAIを使うたびにこう自問しなければなりません。 「この結果は妥当か？」 「自分は規制を守っているか？」 「データを適切に保護しているか？」 この姿勢を持ってはじめて、AIは潜在的リスクではなく、真のビジネスパートナーとなります。 当社は、AIを経営層にとって単なる技術課題ではなく、日本企業の経営力を測る試金石であると考えています。AIは未来を形づくる重要な要素ですが、その真価を引き出せるかどうかは、リスクを認識し、責任をもって導入を推進できるかにかかっています。 #ExtremeVietnam #EXV #ITConsulting #ITService

updates.text: ベトナムか東欧か：日本企業に最適なオフショア拠点はどちらか？ コスト削減だけでは競争優位は築けません。日本語対応、タイムゾーン、技術人材、そしてリスクの安定性――。日本企業にとって重要なのは「どの拠点が自社の戦略にフィットするか」です。本記事では、ベトナムと東欧それぞれの特長を整理しました。 👉 グローバル開発を検討中の方はぜひご一読ください。 #ExtremeVietnam #ITConsulting #ITService

updates.text: Offshore Resilience: ビジネスを停滞させずに迅速に拡大するためのソリューション 「急成長する市場に追いつくため、システム能力を倍にする必要がある。しかし、今のチームはすでに手一杯だ」 「ロードマップでは今四半期中の即時展開が求められる。にもかかわらず、質の高い人材の採用には3〜6ヶ月もかかる」 こうした状況は、決して他人事ではない。多くのマネージャーが直面する厳しい現実だ。 経済が不安定で、人材獲得競争が激化する現代において、社内のテックチームが日々の運用を維持し、同時に市場の要求に合わせて迅速に拡大するのは非常に困難だ。 考えてみてほしい。重要なシステムがとてつもない負荷にさらされているのに、新しい人材を3ヶ月も待つ時間はない状況を。 あるいは、誰もが奪い合うポジションであるプロジェクトマネージャーが見つからず、重要なプロジェクトが停止してしまう状況を。 答えは、既存のチームを入れ替えることでも、高騰し続けるコストをかけて採用を続けることでもない。 本当に必要なのは、適切な外部の助けを、適切なタイミングで迎え入れることである。 これこそが、Offshore Resilienceの力だ。これがあれば、これらの課題がもはやプロジェクトを阻む壁となることはない。 1. もしあなたがテクノロジー企業なら インハウスチームは、すべてのR&D活動の中心を担う。しかし、現実には次のような壁にぶつかることがある。 ロードマップで来四半期に開発スピードを倍にすることが求められるが、社内チームの拡大能力には限界がある。 シニアやエキスパートレベルのトップエンジニアを採用するには、実際に3〜4ヶ月かかり、非常に高いコストがかかる。 2. もしあなたが運用システムに依存するビジネスなら 銀行、物流、製造など、業務がシステムの運用に大きく依存する場合、ITチームはコアシステムの維持に不可欠だ。しかし、彼らは常にメンテナンス、拡張、そして予期せぬ危機への対応に追われ、とてつもないプレッシャーにさらされる。 新しい管理機能を緊急に展開する必要があるが、チームはすでにフル稼働だ。 古いシステムを再構築したり、新しいアプリケーションと連携させたりする必要があるが、社内の能力が限られる。 質の高い国内人材を採用するコストが、予算をはるかに超える。 ____________________________________________________________ これらの状況において、Offshore Resilienceが鍵となる。 テクノロジー企業に対しては、高度な専門性を持つチームを提供し、インハウススタッフとの協力を可能にする。これにより、コアチームは中核技術に集中しながら、野心的な拡大目標を達成できる。 テクノロジー分野以外の企業に対しては、IT部門の戦略的な拡張として機能する。システムのタイムリーな展開やインフラの統合をサポートし、安定した運用と迅速なスケールアップを確実にする。 インハウスチームは基盤だが、急速な成長と市場の変動というプレッシャーに直面すると、その最も強固な基盤でさえ限界に直面する。 Offshore Resilienceは、プロジェクトが中断することなく、重要なシステムが常に安定した状態を保つためのタイムリーなサポートを提供できる。 これにより、技術リーダーは、インハウスチームがビジネスにとって最も重要な目標である「大局」に集中できるという安心感を得られる。 #ExtremeVietnam #EXV #ITconsulting #Offshore

updates.text: オフショアサービス：企業を成長させる戦略的ソリューション グローバル競争が激化するビジネス環境において、オフショアサービスはもはや単なるコスト削減の手段ではありません。それは、企業の能力を拡張し、社内チームを活性化させ、持続的な競争優位性を築くための戦略的ソリューションです。 これらのメリットを最大限に活用するためには、企業はオフショアを「ベンダー」としてではなく、共に成長する「戦略的パートナー」として捉える必要があります。 1. オフショアサービス：実行から戦略的コンサルティングへ よくある間違いは、タスクを委任するだけで、オフショアチームを「指示に従うだけの実行者」と見なすことです。この考え方では、彼らの最大の可能性であるコンサルティング能力を見過ごしてしまいます。 - 専門的なコンサルティング： 多数のプロジェクトや多様な業界での実務経験を持つオフショアパートナーは、技術改善やワークフロー最適化に関する貴重な提案を提供できます。 - 社内リソースの解放： 特定の業務をパートナーに委託することで、企業の社内チームはイノベーション、中核的な製品開発、長期的な戦略目標に集中するための時間とエネルギーを得ることができます。 - 高度な専門知識へのアクセス： 信頼できるオフショアプロバイダーと提携することは、社内チームが不足している専門スキルにアクセスする最も迅速な方法であり、組織全体の能力を向上させます。 2. 地理的な距離を越えて強固な信頼を築く オフショアパートナーシップは、強固な信頼の上に築かれてこそ成功します。地理、コミュニケーション、文化の障壁を乗り越えるために、企業は以下の重要な要素に焦点を当てる必要があります。 - 絶対的な透明性： 透明性は鍵となります。Jira、Redmine、GitHubのような主要なプロジェクト管理ツールを使用することで、すべての要件、進捗、問題がリアルタイムで更新されます。これにより、管理者はレポートを待つことなく常に状況を把握でき、絶対的な安心感を得られます。 - コミュニケーションと文化の架け橋： 文化や言語の違いは誤解を引き起こす可能性があります。**ブリッジSE（BrSE）**や経験豊富なプロジェクトマネージャーの役割は非常に重要です。彼らは単に言葉を翻訳するだけでなく、両者の背景や意図を正確に伝えます。 - グローバルな品質基準： **ISO 9001（品質マネジメント）やISO 27001（情報セキュリティマネジメント）**といった国際的な認証は、プロフェッショナルで信頼性の高い作業プロセスの具体的な証明です。これらは単なる書類ではなく、安全性と品質へのコミットメントであり、重要な業務を委託する管理者に安心感を提供します。 オフショアサービスを活用することで、企業は単なるベンダーではなく、信頼と相乗効果に基づいた持続可能な戦略的パートナーシップを築き、グローバル市場でビジネスを新たな高みへと導くことができます。 #Extremevn #EXV #ITconsulting #ITservices #Offshore

updates.text: 🚨SonicWall SSL VPN exploited - Businesses at risk A hacker group called Akira is actively targeting SonicWall SSL VPN, a widely used remote access tool. By abusing an unpatched flaw and misconfigurations, attackers can break in, steal data, and lock down servers for ransom. 📌Key risks highlighted by Rapid7 and ACSC include: - Password brute-force attacks enabled by unpatched flaw CVE-2024-40766. - Misconfigured LDAP settings, granting excessive privileges to regular accounts. - Publicly exposed Virtual Office portals, allowing attackers to hijack MFA and maintain long-term access. ⚠️These weaknesses give Akira a direct path into corporate networks. In July 2025 alone, the group carried out 40 attacks, mainly against manufacturing and transport. updates.text: 🚨State Bank of Vietnam issues urgent cybersecurity directive following CIC incident On September 11, shortly after the data breach at the National Credit Information Center (CIC) came to light, the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) released an urgent directive to all credit institutions, payment intermediaries, credit information providers, and other financial entities across the sector. 📌 Key requirements: - Fix existing vulnerabilities and weaknesses in IT systems. - Upgrade or replace outdated systems, applications, and operating platforms no longer supported by vendors. - Apply timely security patches to servers, applications, and network devices. - Strengthen internal controls: access management, multi-factor authentication, and encryption of critical data. - Assess third-party risks to prevent supply chain attacks. - Monitor threats continuously and prepare incident response plans. ⚠️Leaders of financial institutions will be held personally accountable before the law and the Governor if cybersecurity breaches or data leaks occur under their watch. 👉The SBV’s message is clear: cybersecurity is not just a technical requirement — it is a mission-critical responsibility to safeguard customers, data, and the integrity of Vietnam’s financial system. 🔗 Read more: https://lnkd.in/gXT_PeWH ---------------------------------------- VNETWORK – Leading Cloud Security Website: www.vnetwork.vn Fanpage: VNETWORK LinkedIn: https://lnkd.in/g7sbDcWe Hotline: (+84)28 7306 8789 Email: contact@vnetwork.vn #VNETWORK #CyberSecurity #AnNinhMang #NganHangNhaNuoc #CIC #DataLeak #DigitalSafety #Fintech #BankingSecurity #ChongTanCongMang

updates.text: 🚨 Alert: Personal data breach at the National Credit Information Center (CIC) On September 10, 2025, the Vietnam Cyber Emergency Response Center (VNCERT) confirmed reports of a cybersecurity incident involving signs of personal data compromise at the National Credit Information Center (CIC). 📌Initial findings: - Evidence of cyberattacks and unauthorized access aimed at stealing personal data. - The exact amount of compromised data is still under investigation. - VNCERT, together with the State Bank of Vietnam and leading security providers, is coordinating technical countermeasures, enhancing security defenses, and collecting digital evidence for legal action. This incident highlights how personal data has become a prime target for cybercriminals. Even a small vulnerability can open the door to malware distribution, scams, and financial fraud. ⚠️VNCERT urges: - Organizations and individuals must not download, share, exploit, or use leaked data. updates.text: 🚨Gmail Phishing evolves - Even AI can be deceived Cybersecurity experts have recently uncovered a highly sophisticated Gmail phishing campaign. Hackers are not only exploiting human psychology but also tricking AI-powered security tools, making detection and prevention harder than ever. 🔎 The attack chain was carefully orchestrated step by step: - The phishing email was sent via SendGrid, passing SPF & DKIM checks to land in inboxes - Its subject line posed as a Gmail warning about an “expiring password,” pressuring recipients to click the link - Hidden within the HTML code, attackers embedded a prompt injection written in the style of ChatGPT/Gemini, tricking AI systems into misinterpreting the threat and skipping alerts - Once clicked, victims were redirected through Microsoft Dynamics, a trusted domain that added credibility - A fake CAPTCHA page was then shown to block bots, crawlers, and automated sandboxes - Finally, users were taken to a spoofed Gmail login page with obfuscated JavaScript designed to steal their credentials 🎯This campaign highlights the evolution of next-gen phishing: exploiting human behavior while simultaneously bypassing AI defenses. Organizations now need proactive, multi-layered email security to stay protected against such advanced threats. 📥 EG-Platform by VNETWORK — the only email security solution fully compliant with ITU standards, powered by AI & Machine Learning, with key capabilities: - Real-time scanning of links and attachments, detecting hidden malicious redirects. - Safe-view conversion: rendering email content as images to eliminate risky clicks. - Blocking phishing, ransomware, and malware right at the gateway. - Full control and monitoring of all inbound and outbound email traffic. 🔗 Read more: https://lnkd.in/gahzpsMK 👉 Try EG-Platform today: https://lnkd.in/gR2zjm7P ---------------------------------------------- VNETWORK - Leading Cloud Security Website: www.vnetwork.vn/ Fanpage: VNETWORK Linkedin: https://lnkd.in/g7sbDcWe Hotline: (+84)28 7306 8789 Email: contact@vnetwork.vn #VNETWORK #EGPlatform #EmailSecurity #Phishing #PromptInjection #CyberAttack #AIsecurity #Ransomware #AnNinhMang #CyberDefense #InboxProtection

about: Vì sao lại hình thành dịch vụ chuyển nhà trọn gói Hà Thành? Trước đây, khi chúng ta có nhu cầu chuyển nhà, chuyển đồ đạc đến địa điểm mới, đã phần mọi người sẽ nhờ người nhà, bạn bè, người quen chuyển. Ngày nay, khối lượng đồ đạc thiết bị tăng dần theo thời gian, địa điểm chuyển cũng mở rộng, đường xá đi lại đông đúc, người thân quen đôi lúc bận rộn khiến việc nhờ người quen trở nên khó khăn hơn, kể cả có nhờ được thì cũng rất vất vả vì mọi người không có kỹ năng, nên mỗi khi chuyển nhà, chuyển văn phòng đã trở thành nỗi lo lắng lớn của rất nhiều người. Rất cần có những công ty cung cấp dịch vụ này. Nắm bắt nhu cầu thị trường đó và đã có sẵn dịch vụ vận tải hàng hóa, Vận chuyển Hà Thành đã cung cấp thêm dịch vụ chuyển nhà trọn gói, chuyển văn phòng trọn gói cho các khách hàng tại khu vực Hà Nội và các vùng lân cận, chúng tôi cung cấp các giải pháp chuyển đồ đạc thiết bị với khối lượng lớn với khoảng cách xa mà vẫn đảm bảo an toàn cho tài sản thiết bị của bạn với chi phí rẻ nhất. Chuyển nhà hà thành là một trong các công ty đầu tiên cung cấp dịch vụ chuyển nhà trọn gói, chuyển văn phòng trọn gói, Với hơn 10 năm kinh nghiệm, Hà Thành đã xây dựng được uy tín và tạo được niềm tin với các khách hàng. Với phương châm ” Khách hàng là thượng đế” Các nhân viên của chuyển nhà Hà Thành luôn phục vụ với tinh thần tận tâm, trách nhiệm. Các khách hàng sau khi sử dụng dịch vụ của Hà Thành lần đầu tiên, đã trở thành khách hàng thân thiết, sau đó giới thiệu cho người thân, bạn bè cùng sử dụng dịch vụ của Hà Thành. Chúng tôi quan niệm khách hàng luôn là người đồng hành, là người quyết định sự phát triển của Hà Thành. Ngoài việc cung cấp các dịch vụ mà khách hàng yêu cầu, với kinh nghiệm của mình, Hà Thành còn tư vấn cho khách hàng các giải pháp để tiết kiệm được chi phí tốt nhất, tiết kiệm thời gian tốt nhất. Với mong muốn cung cấp dịch vụ tiện ích, chất lượng ngày càng cao, chúng tôi luôn mong muốn nhận được sự đóng góp ý kiến, chia sẻ của quý khách hàng, để chúng tôi có

updates.text: VISION 2 - 34 Houses ADA is proceeding with the technical documentation for the construction permit for the 34 homes of our Vision 2 project in Tan Tao ward, HCMC. At the heart of Vision 2 is an innovative approach to affordability and livability. We've engineered a highly optimized sell price per square meter through streamlined construction techniques, yet crucially, each home provides ample space designed for flexible adaptation to diverse family needs and local customs. Our design process is rooted in maximizing intrinsic value: meticulously identifying and capitalizing on every unique site characteristic to elevate the overall design without increasing costs. This project exemplifies our passion for creating impactful design within challenging budget frameworks. We believe in delivering well designed homes that are accessible, proving that thoughtful architecture isn't solely reserved for "iconic" structures, but can significantly enhance everyday living for a broader community.

As an authorized distributor of Topcon's surveying equipment and point cloud processing software, E2CS delivers high-precision, non-disruptive data solutions nationwide, optimizing project timelines and costs. Guided by the motto "Understand – Connect – Accompany," E2CS is dedicated to providing smart, sustainable solutions and partnering with clients to drive lasting value across every project.

updates.text: 🚨Từ 1/7/2025: Chính thức bãi bỏ chứng chỉ năng lực hoạt động xây dựng Từ ngày 01/7/2025, hai thủ tục hành chính liên quan đến việc cấp mới và cấp lại chứng chỉ năng lực hoạt động xây dựng sẽ chính thức bị bãi bỏ. Đây được xem là một bước tiến đột phá trong nỗ lực cải cách hành chính, tháo gỡ rào cản pháp lý và tạo điều kiện thuận lợi hơn cho doanh nghiệp trong lĩnh vực xây dựng. Theo quy định tại khoản 1 Điều 56 của Luật Đường sắt năm 2025, đã có hiệu lực thi hành từ ngày 01/7/2025, các quy định tại khoản 4 Điều 148 và khoản 2 Điều 159 của Luật Xây dựng – vốn yêu cầu tổ chức hoạt động xây dựng phải có chứng chỉ năng lực – chính thức bị loại bỏ. Thay vào đó, các tổ chức sẽ không còn phải thực hiện thủ tục xin cấp chứng chỉ năng lực như trước đây. Việc đánh giá năng lực sẽ do chủ đầu tư hoặc bên mời thầu thực hiện, thông qua hồ sơ năng lực bao gồm các yếu tố như kinh nghiệm thực hiện hợp đồng, nhân sự chủ chốt và thiết bị thi công. Theo Dự thảo Nghị định mới, các tổ chức hoạt động xây dựng sẽ chỉ cần tự khai báo thông tin lên hệ thống năng lực xây dựng quốc gia. Mô hình quản lý mới này hướng tới việc tăng tính minh bạch, trao quyền chủ động đánh giá năng lực cho các chủ thể trực tiếp trong quá trình triển khai dự án, đồng thời khắc phục tình trạng cấp chứng chỉ hình thức, không phản ánh đúng năng lực thực tế của đơn vị. Việc bãi bỏ chứng chỉ năng lực tổ chức được kỳ vọng sẽ giảm đáng kể chi phí tuân thủ, tháo gỡ vướng mắc cho các doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ, và góp phần xây dựng môi trường đầu tư – xây dựng công khai, minh bạch và cạnh tranh lành mạnh hơn. —---------------------------------- CONTACT US: ☎️ Hotline: (+84) 906 973 008 ✉️ Email: infor@e2cs.com.vn 📍 Address: Nguyễn Gia Trí, Phường 25, Bình Thạnh, TP.HCM #E2CS #3DScanning #PointCloud #SmartSurveySolutions #TechnologyForConstruction #LaserScanning #DigitalTwin #SmartPlant3D #EngineeringSolutions #ProjectEfficiency #BãiBỏChứngChỉNăngLực #CảiCáchThủTụcXâyDựng #ChínhSáchMớiNgànhXâyDựng #XâyDựngKhôngCầnChứngChỉ #TựChứngMinhNăngLực #DoanhNghiệpXâyDựng2025 #LuậtXâyDựng2025 #TinNóngXâyDựng #ThayĐổiQuyĐịnhXâyDựng

updates.text: 🌊 E2CS PROUDLY JOINS PTSC IN THE CHW2204 OFFSHORE WIND FARM PROJECT The Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farm – CHW2204 marks a significant milestone for Vietnam’s renewable energy journey. With 33 offshore wind turbine foundations successfully completed, E2CS is honored to contribute as part of PTSC’s subsidiary team, ensuring both technical precision and component quality from the very beginning. During the construction of the Suction Bucket foundations, E2CS’s experienced engineers worked closely on-site with PTSC, utilizing high-tech equipment to deliver: ✅ 3D Laser Scanning for precise geometric measurement of each foundation base → Achieving surface accuracy of ~2mm and distance accuracy of 3.5mm ✅ Detailed analysis reports on: → Flatness, tilt, and ovality of the cylindrical base → Convex-concave surface deformation (Roughness) of the Bucket ✅ On-site collaboration with PTSC’s engineering team → Ensuring every millimeter of deviation is captured, addressed, and strictly controlled ✅ Data-driven comparison with technical thresholds → Supporting precise adjustments to meet performance requirements in high-pressure underwater environments 💡 The application of 3D Laser Scanning marks a breakthrough in construction quality control. For each massive Bucket (D=14m, H=14m), up to 32 million data points were captured, allowing for a full and objective evaluation of the surface, structure, and assembly—vital for components that must perform in extreme offshore conditions. 🌱 These 33 foundations are more than just infrastructure—they represent a synergy of human expertise, cutting-edge technology, and the collective vision to advance Vietnam’s position in offshore wind energy. 💚 Thank you to PTSC for your trust and for allowing E2CS to be part of such a meaningful and forward-looking project! ----------------------------------- CONTACT US: ☎️ Hotline: (+84) 983 039 936 (Mr. Ngọc) ✉️ Email: infor@e2cs.com.vn 📍 Address: Nguyễn Gia Trí, Phường 25, Bình Thạnh, TP.HCM 🌐 Website: https://e2cs.com.vn/ #E2CS #3DScanning #PointCloud #SmartSurveySolutions #TechnologyForConstruction #LaserScanningVietnam #PointCloudtoBIM #3DModeling #BIM #laserscanning #3dlaserscanning #scantobim #OilAndGas #OffshoreEngineering #PlatformMaintenance #EngineeringSurvey #AsBuiltDocumentation #ClashDetection #3DScanning #LaserScanning #DigitalTwin #SmartPlant3D #TeklaStructures #E3DModeling #DigitalTransformation #IndustrialInnovation #EngineeringSolutions #AccuracyMatters #CostOptimization #ProjectEfficiency #DataDrivenDecisions #ConstructionTech #E2CSDigitalSurvey #OptimizeWithE2CS

For each massive Bucket (D=14m, H=14m), up to 32 million data points were captured, allowing for a full and objective evaluation of the surface, structure, and assembly—vital for components that must perform in extreme offshore conditions. 🌱 These 33 foundations are more than just infrastructure—they represent a synergy of human expertise, cutting-edge technology, and the collective vision to advance Vietnam’s position in offshore wind energy. 💚 Thank you to PTSC for your trust and for allowing E2CS to be part of such a meaningful and forward-looking project! ----------------------------------- CONTACT US: ☎️ Hotline: (+84) 983 039 936 (Mr. Ngọc) ✉️ Email: infor@e2cs.com.vn  📍 Address: Nguyễn Gia Trí, Phường 25, Bình Thạnh, TP.HCM 🌐 Website: https://e2cs.com.vn/ #E2CS #3DScanning #PointCloud #SmartSurveySolutions #TechnologyForConstruction #LaserScanningVietnam #PointCloudtoBIM #3DModeling #BIM #laserscanning #3dlaserscanning #scantobim #OilAndGas #OffshoreEngineering #PlatformMaintenance #EngineeringSurvey #AsBuiltDocumentation #ClashDetection #3DScanning #LaserScanning #DigitalTwin #SmartPlant3D #TeklaStructures #E3DModeling #DigitalTransformation #IndustrialInnovation #EngineeringSolutions #AccuracyMatters #CostOptimization #ProjectEfficiency #DataDrivenDecisions #ConstructionTech #E2CSDigitalSurvey #OptimizeWithE2CS

Với 33 chân đế điện gió ngoài khơi hoàn thành, E2CS vinh dự được đồng hành một phần cùng công ty con của PTSC, đóng góp vào việc đảm bảo chính xác về kỹ thuật cũng như chất lượng cấu kiện từ những giai đoạn ban đầu. Phối hợp với các bộ phận khác hoàn thành hợp đồng. • Theo dõi thực hiện hợp đồng bao gồm các thủ tục giao hàng, xuất hóa đơn, thu hồi công nợ. • Chăm sóc, tư vấn, phối hợp giải quyết các khiếu nại của khách hàng về chất lượng sản phẩm, thời gian giao hàng,… 📌 Yêu cầu • Trình độ Cao đẳng trở lên, thuộc các chuyên ngành Kinh tế hoặc các chuyên ngành khác có đam mê/năng khiếu kinh doanh. • Sử dụng thành thạo tin học văn phòng và các phần mềm liên quan đến công việc, làm việc độc lập. • Kỹ năng giao tiếp, thương lượng, thuyết phục tốt. 📌 Quyền lợi • Lương tháng 13. • Thưởng doanh số cuối năm tùy vào mức hoàn thành chỉ tiêu doanh số được giao. • Môi trường làm việc chuyên nghiệp, năng động, cơ hội thăng tiến và phát triển nghề nghiệp. • Được đào tạo về sản phẩm và kỹ năng bán hàng. 🏠 Địa chỉ Công ty: 491/38 Nguyễn Đình Chiểu, P.2, Quận 3, TP.HCM 📩 Ứng tuyển qua email: lighting@toantan.com #tuyendung #hiring #salescareers #salesexecutive #sales

updates.text: ⚡ RoHS – The Mandatory Passport for Electrical and Electronic Products Entering the EU Did you know? 🎯 Just one component exceeding the limits of lead or cadmium can cause your entire shipment to be returned, recalled, or banned from circulation in Europe. That is why the RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances Directive) has become the strictest “gatekeeper” regulation for the electrical and electronics industry. 🔎 RoHS restricts 10 hazardous substances: Heavy metals: Lead (Pb), Mercury (Hg), Cadmium (Cd), Cr6+ Brominated flame retardants: PBB, PBDE Phthalates: DEHP, BBP, DBP, DIBP 💡 Key benefits of RoHS compliance: ✅ Legal – Ensure products are eligible for EU export. ✅ Brand value – Build a green, safe, and sustainable image. ✅ Competitive edge – Gain an advantage over unprepared competitors. 🚀 The greatest challenge for businesses lies in controlling the supply chain and demonstrating compliance. This is where you need a trusted testing partner. ✨ At CTT Lab, our internationally accredited laboratories provide: 📌 RoHS testing & certification for electrical and electronic products. 📌 Supply chain consulting to ensure all materials and components meet standards. 📌 Continuous updates on the latest EU regulations to help you avoid legal risks. 💬 Message for businesses: Don’t let your product “die at the border” just because it lacks RoHS certification. 👉 Contact CTT Lab today for consultation & testing support – helping your products confidently enter the EU market! 🌐 Website: www.cttlab.vn 📞 Hotline: Ms. Huong – +84 962 951 885 #CTTVietnam #TestingLab #RoHS #REACH #ExportCompliance

updates.text: ⚠️🌍 ECHA ANNOUNCES PUBLIC CONSULTATION ON 3 NEW SVHCs 📅 On September 1, 2025, the European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) launched a public consultation regarding 3 new SVHCs (Substances of Very High Concern). ⏳ Consultation period: until October 16, 2025 👉 During this period, all stakeholders may submit feedback directly to ECHA. 📌 If approved, these 3 substances will officially be added to the SVHC Candidate List – an important step in chemical control within the EU under the REACH Regulation. updates.text: NNG welcomes the EMBA cohort from the Foster School of Business, University of Washington (UW)—where culture meets innovation. September 4, 2025 — NNG proudly hosted EMBA from UW, ranked #8 globally by U.S. News & World Report. Our guests hailed from diverse fields, including technology, consulting, healthcare, public service, and education, all driven by a shared curiosity about innovation’s role in transforming organizations. We greeted them with Vietnamese hospitality—Saigon iced coffee with condensed milk, Bánh mì, and Bat Trang pottery coffee filters personalized with their names. What started as a warm welcome blossomed into dynamic discussions about how AI, Azure, and IoT are shaping the future of business. At NNG, we demonstrated that these technologies are real, practical competencies, providing scalable, secure, and data-driven solutions for today’s challenges and tomorrow’s opportunities. This exchange reinforced our conviction that technology has the greatest impact when it bridges cultures and industries. We thank the UW delegation for their insights and look forward to future collaborations between NNG and UW.

updates.text: NNG Accelerates Global Growth with New Singapore Office Opening August 15, 2025 – NNG, an IT solutions provider focused on software development for businesses and enterprises, is excited to announce the official launch of its new Singapore office. This significant expansion establishes Singapore as “NNG’s International Gateway," bridging Asia, Europe, and North America through a hub of innovation, digital transformation, and AI advancement. “This is more than just an expansion – it's a statement of our commitment to excellence worldwide,” said Dung Ho (Leo), General Director of NNG. “Our Singapore office is a global hub where technology, innovation, and talent intersect. From here, we plan to support businesses worldwide with comprehensive, top-notch IoT software development, Microsoft Solutions, and cutting-edge digital and AI transformation services.” Key Strategic Focus from the Singapore Office: - We are dedicated to achieving Global Software Development Excellence by delivering high-quality, scalable, and affordable software solutions tailored specifically for our multinational clients. - Our commitment to Sustainable Cross-Border Partnerships helps connect Vietnam’s top IT talent with global innovation centers, fostering efficiency, security, and long-term business growth. - Additionally, we strive to enhance our expertise in IoT and Microsoft Azure, ensuring we stay at the forefront of technology. This milestone embodies NNG’s goal to serve as a global conduit of innovation—linking Vietnam’s outstanding IT skills with international markets. It aims to provide technology that supports enterprise growth and strengthens resilience in the digital era. Guided by a Board of Directors with extensive global business and tech backgrounds, NNG is well-equipped to help organizations attain global competitiveness and develop sustainable, long-term collaborations.

YouNet Group is the Pioneering Data Intelligence Ecosystem for Digital Commerce in SEA.

YouNet Group is Southeast Asia’s pioneering Data Intelligence ecosystem — the first to own and unify both Social and E-commerce data platforms, transforming them into integrated intelligence systems that deliver both Actionable Insights and Solutions for digital commerce.
Founded in Vietnam and the United States, YouNet Group has evolved into a multi-entity ecosystem of 7 specialized companies — each contributing deep expertise in market research, E-commerce analytics, social advocacy, creative strategy, community engagement, and enterprise platforms.

At the heart of our value lies integration: we connect Social and E-commerce data with technology, creativity, and execution to help brands grow smarter and faster in the digital economy.

✅ Mission
To pioneer the convergence of Social and E-commerce data into a unified Data Intelligence system — enabling brands to unlock growth through insights-driven and solution-based integration.

✅ Vision
To become the world’s first integrated Data Intelligence ecosystem owning both Social & E-commerce platforms — and Southeast Asia’s most trusted partner for sustainable brand growth in digital commerce.

updates.text: Bulk Shipping Trends: What’s Driving the Market Over the Next 5 Years? As global demand shifts, coal and iron ore will continue to dominate the bulk shipping landscape, with some key takeaways for the future: 1. Iron ore demand remains strong despite the move toward green steel and Electric Arc Furnaces (EAFs). Limited scrap availability means iron ore will still be critical, especially with construction booms in India and China. 2. Australia’s coking coal exports are set to decline, as China pivots to sourcing from Russia and Mongolia. This shift will reduce shipping demand, particularly for Capesize vessels, as shorter routes are utilized. 3. India is the rising star in steel production, projected to double output in five years, significantly increasing its demand for coking coal. This will make India a key driver for shipping demand and longer routes, boosting freight rates. 4. Freight costs to rise through 2025 due to supply-side pressures, including new emission regulations, carbon taxes, and ship demolitions. Rates are expected to ease by 2026 as new vessels come into service. 5. The future of bulk shipping is shifting east, with India set to drive the freight market and become a major player in global commodities by 2030. #wodagri #bulk #freight #shipping

locations: No 01 Hung Vuong street, Hoa Phu ward Thu Dau Mot, Binh Duong, VN
about: Nhà phát triển đô thị BECAMEX TOKYU là Liên Doanh uy tín Việt- Nhật giữa Tập đoàn Phát triển đô thị TOKYU CORPORATION với hơn 100 năm phát triển đô thị tại Nhật Bản và Tổng Công ty BECAMEX IDC- nhà phát triển hạ tầng công nghiệp, phát triển đô thị hàng đầu tại Việt Nam. Với 12 năm phát triển, BECAMEX TOKYU kiến tạo một đô thị hiện đại theo tiêu chuẩn toàn cầu tại Thành Phố Mới Bình Dương và đang tiếp tục mở rộng xa hơn đến các địa bàn lân cận, đặc biệt là TP. HCM. Với những nỗ lực không ngừng nghỉ của toàn thể đội ngũ nhân viên, từng dự án của BECAMEX TOKYU đã và đang được công nhận, đánh giá cao từ Khách hàng, Cư dân cũng như các Tổ chức trong ngành với các giải thưởng về Thương hiệu, Kiến trúc, Xây dựng uy tín. Trụ sở chính BECAMEX TOKYU tọa lạc tại WTC TOWER (số 1, Đại Lộ Hùng Vương, Phường Hòa Phú, TP. Thủ Dầu Một, tỉnh Bình Dương), một trong những cao ốc hiện đại bậc nhất tại trung tâm Thành Phố Mới Bình Dương với các tiện ích văn phòng hàng đầu, quan tâm sâu sắc đến sự cân bằng cuộc sống - công việc, hạnh phúc và sự phát triển của toàn thể nhân viên. Với kế hoạch phát triển dài hạn và bền vững, BECAMEX TOKYU không ngừng tìm kiếm ứng viên tài năng- những ai có ước mơ lớn cùng chung tay xây dựng không chỉ những dự án mà còn cả thành phố mà mọi người đều mong muốn được sống, làm việc và tham quan tại TPM Bình Dương. Hãy khám phá các cơ hội nghề nghiệp với chúng tôi NGAY BÂY GIỜ nếu bạn đam mê phát triển các Dự án Dân cư & Thương mại cùng các chuyên gia đáng tin cậy được kế thừa hơn 100 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển đô thị đến từ Nhật Bản.

updates.text: The 9th Annual Christmas Charity Ride: A Journey of Joy From December 13th to 15th, the Al Naboodah Vietnam team joined forces with hundreds of fellow bikers on a nearly 400-kilometer adventure. Our destination? To bring the spirit of Christmas to underprivileged children in Dak Lak province. Loaded with over 500 million VND worth of gifts – including clean water systems, essential school supplies, bicycles, and more – we visited Kim Dong Primary School, Ea Bong Primary School, and Buu Thang 2 Orphanage. These heartwarming visits brought joy to nearly 400 children, many of whom belong to ethnic minority communities. This impactful journey would not have been possible without the generous support of philanthropic individuals, our esteemed sponsors, and the dedicated riders who joined us. We are immensely grateful for your compassion and unwavering support. We look forward to embarking on many more such journeys in the future, spreading joy and making a lasting difference in the lives of those in need. #alnaboodah #alnaboodahvietnam #christmascharityride #ccr2024

The V Language has:
- 2 centers
- More than 50 experienced, qualified, and dedicated teachers and tutors
- Served more than 2000 students

At The V Language, we always bring the best learning experiences to the students. As  one of the first centers to pioneer  in using the personalization method to educate students,  the curriculum is designed and implemented based on learners’ characteristics to maximise the effectiveness of the learning process. 

Thanks to its continuous effort in raising the quality of training and service, since July 2020, The V Language has been proudly certified as a silver partner with British Council. This is a significant milestone to mark all the accomplishments and progress of The V Language in the educational sector.

locations: 252 Cua Dai Street, Cam Chau Ward Hoi An, Quang Nam 560000, VN
about: (Vietnamese caption below) 06 luxurious villas in total which are located between Hoi An ancient town and the beautiful Cua Dai beach, only 3km far away from the centre of Hoi An town and surrounded by the peaceful & romantic river in front and the green rice fields in the back. Each villa has: * 5 BEDROOMS: 40 square meters for each room (with balcony / terrace) offering a touch of Hoi An traditional architectural design combined with a taste of modern luxury in every single painting, lantern and so on… Amenities are well-equipped for the uttermost relaxation and leave you a memorable experience about the pure nature and honest local culture. * PRIVATE POOL: 36 square-meters. It's an ideal venue for BBQ party or swimming. * A LARGE AREA OF LIVING AND DINNING ROOM (with KITCHEN). This is the place for the whole family gather together for breakfasts or dinners, telling excited stories about a discovery day in the ancient Hoi An. .............. HOA CỌ VILLAS là cụm villa chỉ cách trung tâm phố cổ khoảng 3km và cách bờ biển Cửa Đại khoảng 2km. Quang cảnh phía trước của cụm biệt thự là dòng sông êm đềm thơ mộng, phía sau được bao bọc bởi cánh đồng lúa xanh mượt. Tổng cộng có 06 căn villa. Mỗi căn villa gồm: * 5 PHÒNG NGHỈ: diện tích mỗi phòng 40 m2 (có ban công / hiên) được thiết kế hài hòa pha trộn nét cổ điển và hiện đại với nội thất gỗ tinh tế, mang đậm phong cách văn hóa Hội An qua các điểm nhấn đặc trưng của những bức tranh sơn dầu, lồng đèn phố Hội,… * HỒ BƠI RIÊNG: diện tích 36 m2, để du khách đắm mình trong làn nước mát lạnh, xua tan nóng oi ả của mùa hè. Quanh hồ bơi là sân vườn thoáng rộng có thể tận dụng tổ chức một bữa tiệc BBQ ấm cúng với gia đình và bạn bè vào mỗi buổi tối. * KHU VỰC PHÒNG KHÁCH + PHÒNG ĂN (có BẾP): là nơi để cả gia đình sum vầy bên bữa sáng hay những buổi tối, cùng kể nhau nghe những điều thú vị của một ngày khám phá miền đất cổ này.
specialties: Kid Friendly, villa hoi an, parking lot, private pool, 5-bedroom-villa, kitchen, living and dining room, pool for party, bedroom with balcony, Breakfast included, 3km to ancient town, and suitable for group / family

updates.text: 🌱 Great news for Vietnam’s agri-food landscape! 🇻🇳🇳🇱 🤝 Recently, FMO - Dutch entrepreneurial development bank has signed a $20 million cooperation agreement with Nafoods Group , one of #Vietnam ’s leading fruit processors and exporters, marking #FMO ’s first investment in #Asia ’s fruit processing sector!🌱 By investing in: ✔️ expanding production ✔️ promoting sustainable practices ✔️ strengthening operations ⏩ This agreement helps modernize the fruit supply chain. And with this support, Nafoods is set to become a regional leader in producing high-quality processed #fruit . 🌍 Why does this matter❔ 🌾 Vietnam’s fruit industry is booming, with exports reaching $7.15 billion in 2024, and ambitious goals of hitting $10 billion by 2030. 🍍 Yet only 12–17% of fruit production is processed, showing massive untapped potential. 🚛 Challenges such as post-harvest loss, disjointed logistics, and underdeveloped infrastructure persist. Read more in this article: https://lnkd.in/gDx6MX-Z #NLinVN #AgroBerichtenBuitenland #Netherlands #Vietnam #Sustainable #AgriFood #FruitExport #Partnership #Strategic #Cooperation #SupplyChain #Agreement The Kingdom of the Netherlands in Vietnam | Netherlands Agricultural Network | Ingrid Korving | Huong Lan Nguyen | Phuong Dung Le | Hien Pham | Bas Rekvelt

updates.text: In October 2021, with the goal of supplying a significant portion of the mall’s energy needs from clean energy and reducing dependence on the national grid, the rooftop solar power project was initiated, with Aeon Mall Long Bien as the investor and Hawee Energy as the main contractor. However, a challenge arose for the company’s engineers, as, under Vietnamese law, Aeon Mall Long Bien is classified as a Grade I building (serving over 10,000 people) and is required to meet higher technical and safety standards. Additionally, at the time of construction, Aeon Mall Long Bien was still under warranty by Obayashi Corporation, one of Japan's leading general contractors. Upon receiving information on the project's current status, Hawee Energy's engineers immediately organized meetings and surveys to present a technical plan that ensured the safety of the mall’s regular operations and did not impact elements like the building's structure or waterproofing, which were still under Obayashi’s warranty. Strict legal procedures, combined with the need to maintain safety for customers visiting the mall during rooftop construction, led to project delays. However, with the advanced technical expertise of its engineers—proven in projects like the Tan A Ha Nam Factory, Hong Liem 3, TTC Đuc Hue 1, and Binh Nguyen—and a strong determination to complete the project, Hawee Energy successfully achieved its goal in May 2022, including the installation of the rooftop solar panel system at Aeon Mall Long Bien, which was handed over to the investor for use.

updates.text: TikTok Beauty Fest đã khép lại với muôn vàn sắc màu cùng những khoảnh khắc bùng nổ cảm xúc! 🎉 CEO Niki Nguyễn đại diện Hepmil Vietnam tự hào nhận giải thưởng Đối tác sáng tạo nội dung và vận hành livestream tại sự kiện làm đẹp lớn nhất năm – sự ghi nhận cho những nỗ lực không ngừng trong việc sáng tạo, kết nối và lan tỏa giá trị. 📽 Hepmil Việt Nam đã mang phòng livestream O2O (online to offline và ngược lại) kết hợp hệ thống đa góc máy đến Beauty Fest, thu hút hơn 10.0000 khán giả tham quan đến từ khắp cả nước. 💄 Chưa dừng lại ở đó, Orange, Phạm Quỳnh Anh và Phương Anh Đào đã ghé thăm booth nhà Hepmil Việt Nam, mang đến những khoảnh khắc giao lưu khó quên cùng các phiên live bùng nổ. Cùng đón chờ video recap để nhìn lại những khoảnh khắc đáng nhớ nhất từ sự kiện lần này! 🔥 Đừng quên follow tag Hepmil Vietnam ngay hôm nay để không bỏ lỡ những dự án bùng nổ tiếp theo cùng chúng tôi! 🙏 Cảm ơn đội ngũ TikTok for Business đã trao cơ hội để Hepmil Vietnam được trở thành đối tác sáng tạo nội dung và vận hành livestream tại sự kiện làm đẹp lớn nhất năm. Thật là một vinh dự khi được đồng hành và đóng góp vào một lễ hội rực rỡ, đầy cảm hứng về sắc đẹp, sự sáng tạo và cộng đồng. --- A proud moment for Hepmil Vietnam at TikTok Beauty Fest 2025! 💫 🎉 CEO Niki Nguyen proudly represented Hepmil Vietnam in receiving the Content Creation & Livestream Operations Partner Award at the biggest beauty event of the year — a well-deserved recognition for our ongoing efforts in creativity, connection, and value-driven storytelling. 📽 At the heart of the event, Hepmil Vietnam brought an advanced O2O livestream studio (online-to-offline ) combined with a multi-camera setup to TikTok Beauty Fest, attracting over 10,000 visitors from across the country and creating a seamless online and offline experience. 💄 And that’s not all — top artists Orange, Phạm Quỳnh Anh, and Phương Anh Đào visited the Hepmil Vietnam booth, adding even more excitement and unforgettable interactions to our live sessions. 🎬 Stay tuned for the official recap video, where we’ll revisit the most memorable highlights of the festival! 🔥 Don’t forget to follow and tag Hepmil Vietnam to make sure you don’t miss out on our next explosive projects in the world of content and livestream innovation! 🙏 Huge thanks to the TikTok for Business team for the opportunity to become the Content Creation & Livestream Operations Partner at the biggest beauty event of the year. It was an honor for Hepmil Vietnam to contribute to such a vibrant and meaningful celebration of beauty, creativity, and community. #HepmilVietnam #TikTokVietnam #SocialCommerce #Livestreaming

updates.text: 🇻🇳 Exploring Ho Chi Minh City - Unveiling Vietnam’s Thriving Live Commerce Scene During the final leg of my Southeast Asia study tour, Vietnam left an indelible mark with its dynamic and innovative live shopping landscape. 🎥 This brief video encapsulates the essence of my visit to Ho Chi Minh City, showcasing the pulsating energy of the market through insightful on-ground interactions. Key Takeaways from this burgeoning domain: - Vietnam's e-commerce sector is poised to surpass $30 billion by 2025, experiencing a remarkable 23% annual growth rate. - With a mobile-first approach led by Gen Z, a staggering 96% of online transactions occur through smartphones. - Live commerce has become a norm, witnessing 2.5 million monthly livestreams by 50,000 sellers, spanning various industries from beauty to culinary and electronics. - TikTok Shop Shop and Shopee reign supreme, with TikTok exhibiting a remarkable year-on-year growth of +99%. - Influencers and Livestream Gods play a pivotal role in driving robust engagement and conversions. - Government intervention aims to regulate and foster trust on a broader scale. - Live shopping isn't just a trend; it's a profound cultural practice with omnichannel prospects and abundant opportunities for global brands. 🙏 Heartfelt gratitude to all individuals who contributed to enriching this segment of the tour: Hà Nguyễn Thị Hải , Thuy Linh Hoang , Duc Phan , Anh Phuc Nguyen , Hieu Do, Max Nguyen , Tuong Vy Nguyen , Niki Nguyen and the dedicated teams at Hepmil Vietnam Vietnam and VML Vietnam. #SocialCommerce #LiveShopping #Vietnam #Ecommerce #StudyTour #TikTokShop #Shopee #DigitalAsia

updates.text: During my study tour in Southeast Asia, I delved into Vietnam’s thriving live shopping scene, courtesy of Hepmil Vietnam and the gracious hosts Max Nguyen and Tuong Vy Nguyen . The experience included three well-executed live sessions showcasing VINASOY , SUNHOUSE GROUP , and Vinamilk , highlighting the diverse range of products featured beyond just fashion and beauty. What caught my attention was the expansion of live shopping in Vietnam beyond traditional sectors, now encompassing food, fresh goods, and appliances, demonstrating its versatility across industries. Looking ahead to 2024, key statistics reveal the significant impact of live shopping in Vietnam: - 95% of online consumers in Vietnam made purchases through live streams in Q1, according to the Vietnam E-commerce Association. - Users dedicate an average of 13 hours per week to watching live shopping content, as reported by the Vietnam Economic Times. - The e-commerce market surged to $25 billion, marking a 20% year-over-year increase. - Shopee leads the market with $9.3 billion in Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), capturing a 66.7% share and a 41% growth, while TikTok Shop experienced a remarkable 99% surge to $3.8 billion GMV, holding a 26.9% share. Vietnam emerges as a dynamic live shopping hub with widespread consumer engagement and product diversity, offering substantial conversion potential and omnichannel prospects that extend beyond conventional sectors, inspiring innovative strategies for brands. Special thanks to Hepmil Vietnam , Niki Nguyen Max Nguyen , and Tuong Vy Nguyen for the invaluable insights. Stay tuned for further exploration of best practices and opportunities for European brands in this vibrant market. #LiveShopping #Ecommerce #Vietnam #DigitalInnovation #RetailAsia #SocialCommerce

about: Vimarine is a company whose main activity is selling motor boats and yachts in Vietnam and other countries of Asia. The company is the official exclusive distributor of following brands in Vietnam: Azimut Yachts (premium Italian yachts from 12 to 35 meters), Monterey Boats (American speed motor boats), Nautique (American professional motor boats for wakeboarding and wake surfing), and Beneteau (French recreational and fishing boats with outboard engines) Vimarine also sells used motor boats and yachts, provides aftersales and warranty services and does installations of additional equipment. Out company has been working on the market of yachts and motor boats for over 17 years which allows us provide a comprehensive solution to issues related to purchasing a motor yacht or boat. This includes construction on request or selecting a used boat, delivery to Vietnam, customs clearance, and registration at the relevant authorized agencies of the Ministry of Water Transport of Vietnam. We provide consulting services and assistance in hiring crew whose professional duties are related to exploitation of water transports, finding berthing area for motor boats or yachts, setting up maintenance plans. The core principles of the company’s activities are high standards of service, co-operation with leading manufacturers on the market, delivery of high quality authentic equipment and strict commitment to fulfilling our obligations.

updates.text: THE POWER IN YOUR PROMPT In today’s world, we cannot deny the presence of AI. Headlines everywhere warn that AI will soon replace humans in many fields. But for Matt Millard, Founder & CEO of PurpleAsia, AI isn’t a threat - it’s a powerful tool, a servant that helps us achieve the best results. As he puts it, only those who don’t know how to use AI risk losing their jobs. He firmly believes in the power of crafting the right prompts to unlock creativity in AI. Take branding as an example. Branding is a vast concept, it encompasses all the activities and strategies that shape how customers see, feel, and connect with a brand. If you use a simple, generic prompt, AI will return a basic, fact-driven response. This kind of content may quickly lose attention because most audiences already know it. But when you provide a more detailed and creative prompt, specifying tone, references, style, and storytelling, the result becomes richer, more engaging content that truly resonates and keeps the audience engaged longer. ---- 🚀 info@purpleasia.com 💥 +84 (0)28 6277 7050

updates.text: 🌟 Cuộc Cách Mạng Logistics: Tương Lai Chuỗi Cung Ứng trong Kỷ Nguyên Số 🌟 Ngành logistics đang trải qua một cuộc cách mạng chuyển đổi mạnh mẽ nhờ toàn cầu hóa và sự bùng nổ của thương mại điện tử. Công nghệ tiên tiến, nhu cầu tiêu dùng thay đổi và áp lực về phát triển bền vững đang định hình lại cách vận hành của chuỗi cung ứng. Dưới đây là những xu hướng chính đang định hình tương lai của ngành logistics: 💎 Trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) & Tự động hóa: AI giúp tối ưu hóa dự báo nhu cầu và tuyến vận chuyển, trong khi robot và drone giúp cắt giảm chi phí. McKinsey dự đoán rằng tự động hóa có thể giảm chi phí vận hành kho lên tới 30% vào năm 2030. 💎 Logistics Xanh: Nhiên liệu sinh học, bao bì thân thiện với môi trường và tối ưu hóa lộ trình giúp giảm lượng khí thải. Maersk đặt mục tiêu đạt phát thải ròng bằng 0 vào năm 2040. 💎 Giao Hàng Siêu Nhanh: Thương mại điện tử thúc đẩy nhu cầu giao hàng trong ngày, với sự hỗ trợ từ các trung tâm hoàn tất đơn hàng quy mô nhỏ trong đô thị. Thị trường giao hàng chặng cuối toàn cầu dự kiến đạt 200 tỷ USD vào năm 2027 (theo Statista). 💎 Blockchain: Tăng cường tính minh bạch, khả năng truy xuất nguồn gốc và niềm tin, với các công ty như IBM và Walmart tiên phong ứng dụng vào chuỗi cung ứng. 🔍 Thách Thức & Cơ Hội: Tình trạng thiếu lao động, chi phí nhiên liệu tăng và biến động địa chính trị là những thách thức lớn, nhưng cũng là động lực cho đổi mới sáng tạo. 📍 Kết luận: Logistics đang ở ngã rẽ giữa đổi mới và tăng trưởng. Việc ứng dụng công nghệ và hướng đến phát triển bền vững là chìa khóa để vươn lên dẫn đầu. Bạn nghĩ xu hướng nào sẽ định hình ngành logistics trong 5 năm tới? updates.text: Tối Ưu Chi Phí Logistics Mùa Cao Điểm: Chiến Lược Vượt Trội Trong bối cảnh thương mại toàn cầu cạnh tranh khốc liệt, logistics chiếm 15–20% chi phí doanh nghiệp, đặc biệt khi cước vận tải biển tăng 25% vào mùa cao điểm. Tối ưu chi phí logistics không chỉ giúp giảm giá thành mà còn nâng cao lợi thế cạnh tranh và đảm bảo giao hàng đúng hạn. Vậy làm thế nào để đạt được điều này? 1. Lựa chọn Incoterms thông minh Incoterms không chỉ là quy tắc thương mại, mà còn là công cụ phân bổ chi phí, rủi ro và trách nhiệm giữa bên mua và bán: FOB: Giảm chi phí vận chuyển quốc tế, tránh biến động cước. CIF: Chủ động đàm phán giá tàu, bảo hiểm, đảm bảo quyền lợi. 2. Chọn phương thức vận chuyển phù hợp Đường biển: Chi phí thấp, phù hợp hàng số lượng lớn, nhưng thời gian vận chuyển dài (20–40 ngày). Hàng không: Nhanh (2–5 ngày), lý tưởng cho hàng giá trị cao, chi phí cao hơn. Đường sắt: Tiết kiệm, thân thiện môi trường, nhưng hạn chế tuyến. Đường bộ: Linh hoạt nội địa, chi phí cao cho quãng đường dài 3. Tối ưu vận tải Đa phương thức: Kết hợp các phương thức vận tải khác nhau, giúp giảm áp lực lên một phương thức duy nhất, từ đó giảm chi phí. Đa dạng tuyến: So sánh các hãng vận tải để tìm giá tốt và thời gian giao hàng nhanh. Hợp đồng dài hạn: Với nhu cầu vận chuyển lớn, hợp đồng dài hạn với đối tác logistics đảm bảo giá ưu đãi và ổn định chi phí. 📍 Gulf Shipping Co., Ltd. updates.text: Rising Global Logistics Costs: A Challenge Despite Cost-Cutting Efforts 🚢📦 Global logistics costs are on an upward trajectory, projected to reach $14.4 trillion by 2029, a 12% increase from current levels, according to Stocklytics. Despite companies’ continuous efforts to optimize operations and cut expenses, logistics remains a significant financial burden. The Growing Cost of Logistics In 2024, businesses worldwide are expected to spend $12.8 trillion on logistics—$330 billion more than in 2023. This rise is driven by multiple factors: 🔹 Supply Chain Disruptions – Geopolitical tensions, natural disasters, and global crises continue to impact freight rates and delivery timelines. 🔹 Infrastructure Limitations – Many regions still struggle with outdated transportation systems, increasing inefficiencies. 🔹 Rising Fuel & Labor Costs – The cost of fuel, labor shortages, and wage hikes contribute significantly to increasing logistics expenses. 🔹 E-commerce Boom – The shift toward online shopping and fast delivery expectations has placed higher demand on logistics networks, raising costs. 🔹 Regulatory & Compliance Costs – Stricter environmental and trade regulations are adding new financial pressures on logistics providers. How do you see logistics evolving in the next five years? updates.text: Peugeot Việt Nam xin chúc mừng chị Lê Phạm Quỳnh Như - Peugeot Khánh Hòa đã xuất sắc dẫn đầu toàn quốc trong chương trình khảo sát sự hài lòng khách hàng mua xe mới Peugeot (Peugeot SSI do tập đoàn Stellantis khu vực ASEAN tổ chức) và được vinh danh là Tư vấn bán hàng có hoạt động chăm sóc khách hàng tốt nhất Quý I/2025. Với sự chuyên nghiệp, tận tâm và phong cách làm việc chỉn chu từ đầu đến cuối, chị Quỳnh Như đã xây dựng được niềm tin và sự hài lòng vững chắc từ khách hàng - những người lựa chọn Peugeot là người bạn đồng hành trong hành trình của mình. Bên cạnh đó, Peugeot Việt Nam cũng trân trọng tuyên dương các Tư vấn bán hàng có hoạt động chăm sóc khách hàng nổi bật trong Quý I/2025: - Nguyễn Ngọc Hải – Peugeot Nghệ An - Tạ Thị Anh Đào – Peugeot Trường Chinh (TP.HCM) - Nguyễn Ngọc Việt – Peugeot Hải Phòng - Đào Bích Phương – Peugeot Thái Nguyên Peugeot Việt Nam xin chân thành cảm ơn các anh/chị tư vấn viên trên toàn quốc đã không ngừng nỗ lực vì sự hài lòng của khách hàng, góp phần lan tỏa những giá trị bền vững trong hành trình phát triển của thương hiệu. Xin cảm ơn quý khách hàng đã luôn tin tưởng và lựa chọn đồng hành cùng thương hiệu Peugeot trong hành trình 215 năm sáng tạo và đổi mới. #Peugeot #PeugeotVietnam #PeugeotSSI

about: AusCham represents and promotes the interests of Australian businesses operating in Vietnam. We, as a not-for-profit chamber of commerce are proud to have a pivotal function in providing invaluable business and cultural support to members and sponsors' activities and needs in Vietnam and Australia. AusCham provides all members with a voice to express their views on the business environment of Vietnam, directly within the business community and via our liaison with the Vietnam Government through the VBF (Vietnam Business Forum). We actively coordinate a regular program of high-profile business seminars, networking, and social functions as well as a number of charity events in the year. Whilst AusCham covers a wide range of activities, our main objective is to enhance business ties between Australia and Vietnam for the mutual benefit of our members and their Vietnamese counterparts. Furthermore, we keep you up to date with the latest in Vietnam’s business news and any changes by way of our newsletters, alerts and by conducting mon We provide key business and cultural support to our members and sponsors activities in this country. AusCham provides all its members with a voice to express their views on the business environment in Vietnam, directly within the business community and via our liaison with the Vietnamese Government. We actively co-ordinate a regular program of business seminars, networking and social functions. AusCham has a national presence with its Board comprising 4 Directors based in Hanoi and 12 Directors based in HCMC, supported by a secretariat in both cities. In addition, "Official Representatives" are based in Danang and HCMC. AusCham Vietnam is a founding member of AustCham ASEAN https://www.linkedin.com/company-beta/13340863 and Australia Business Asia. Membership of AusCham is open to Australian citizens, individuals working in Australian businesses or on Australian projects in Vietnam, or with organisations that have a link to Australia.

updates.text: [𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐩 𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫] 𝐔𝐧𝐦𝐚𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐃𝐫. 𝐘𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐉𝐞𝐞 𝐄𝐮𝐧: 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐌𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐤-𝐔𝐩𝐬 🛡️ Early detection is one of the most powerful tools in protecting our health. Many serious illnesses, often called “silent diseases”, can develop without symptoms until they reach advanced stages. With regular check-ups and preventive care, these risks can be uncovered before they progress, giving us the chance to intervene early and effectively. At the upcoming workshop, we aim to empower women in their own health and recognize their invaluable role in safeguarding the well-being of their families by having Dr. Yang Jee Eun, M.D., Internal Medicine and Gastroenterology Specialist at H PLUS International Medical Center , share her expertise with our community. Dr. Yang Jee Eun is a specialist in internal medicine and gastroenterology with extensive clinical, academic, and international experience. 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐧 𝐃𝐮𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 🌟 When it comes to shaping spaces that balance experience, wellness, and sustainability, few leaders stand out like Mr. Thien Duong. We are delighted to have him as the first keynote speaker at our workshop "𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 & 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐬: 𝐈𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐧 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐒𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲". Mr. Thien currently leads GroupGSA Vietnam, an Australian architectural firm with over 45 years of global design experience. A Chartered Member of the Royal Institute of British Architects, he has delivered award-winning projects across Vietnam, the United Kingdom, Canada, Africa, and Australia. With over 25 years of expertise, his work spans Interior Design, urban planning, and Architecture across diverse sectors, including international education, commercial mixed-use developments, hotels, resorts, and large-scale residential projects. Holding Honours Degrees in Architecture and Environmental Studies from the University of Waterloo in Canada and Italy, Mr. Thien also serves as Chairman of the Judges for the Vietnam Property Awards and Asia Property Awards, and sits on the Board of Directors of the Vietnam Green Building Council. Join us to gain insights from one of the most influential voices in design as we reimagine the future of hospitality and workspaces. 🗓️ 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐞: Tuesday, October 28th ⏰ 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞: 3:30 pm – 6:00 pm 📍 𝐕𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞: The Sentry C, Sonatus Building, 15 Le Thanh Ton, Saigon Ward, HCMC 🎟️ 𝐓𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐭𝐬: Free for AusCham members | 300,000 VND for non-members 🔗 𝐑𝐞𝐠𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐤: https://lnkd.in/g7ewT4TU #AusChamVietnam #GroupGSA #FutureOfWorkspaces #HospitalityDesign #KeynoteSpeaker

unformatted_about:
AusCham represents and promotes the interests of Australian businesses operating in Vietnam. We, as a not-for-profit chamber of commerce are proud to have a pivotal function in providing invaluable business and cultural support to members and sponsors' activities and needs in Vietnam and Australia.

AusCham provides all members with a voice to express their views on the business environment of Vietnam, directly within the business community and via our liaison with the Vietnam Government through the VBF (Vietnam Business Forum). We actively coordinate a regular program of high-profile business seminars, networking, and social functions as well as a number of charity events in the year.

Whilst AusCham covers a wide range of activities, our main objective is to enhance business ties between Australia and Vietnam for the mutual benefit of our members and their Vietnamese counterparts. Furthermore, we keep you up to date with the latest in Vietnam’s business news and any changes by way of our newsletters, alerts and by conducting mon
We provide key business and cultural support to our members and sponsors activities in this country.

AusCham provides all its members with a voice to express their views on the business environment in Vietnam, directly within the business community and via our liaison with the Vietnamese Government. We actively co-ordinate a regular program of business seminars, networking and social functions.

AusCham has a national presence with its Board comprising 4 Directors based in Hanoi and 12 Directors based in HCMC, supported by a secretariat in both cities. In addition, "Official Representatives" are based in Danang and HCMC.

AusCham Vietnam is a founding member of AustCham ASEAN https://www.linkedin.com/company-beta/13340863 and Australia Business Asia.

Membership of AusCham is open to Australian citizens, individuals working in Australian businesses or on Australian projects in Vietnam, or with organisations that have a link to Australia.

about: Mercedes Trường Chinh là một trong những đại lý phân phối lớn nhất Mercedes-Benz tại Hồ Chí Minh nói riêng cũng như Việt Nam nói chung. Đến với showroom Trường Chinh, quý khách hàng có thể dễ dàng tìm thấy tất cả các dòng xe mới nhất: A-Class, CLA-Class, C-Class, E-Class, S-CLass, GLA-Class, GLC-Class, GLE-Class, GLS-Class, G-Class, AMG, Dream Car và tất nhiên không thể thiếu Maybach. Tất cả tạo nên một hệ sinh thái vô cùng đa dạng và nhiều sự lựa chọn cho quý khách hàng. Ngoài ra Mercedes còn kinh doanh xe đã qua sử dụng PE (Proven Exclusivity) và các dòng xe tải Fuso với cam kết chất lượng cao nhất cùng chính sách hậu mãi lâu dài và chuyên nghiệp bao gồm: dịch vụ bảo hành, bảo trì, bảo dưỡng, sửa chữa hay đồng sơn và cứu hộ khẩn cấp ... Từ khi thành lập, VSA thường xuyên đạt các giải thưởng doanh số, dịch vụ xuất sắc và đạt chỉ số hài lòng khách hàng CSI (Customer Satisfaction Index) cao nhất trong tất cả các đại lý của hãng liên tiếp từ năm 2008 đến 2015. Trong đó, showroom Trường Chinh là đại lý đầu tiên và cũng là đại lý lâu đời nhất của VSA tại hcm. Mọi chi tiết quý khách hàng có thể liên hệ: + Số điện thoại: 0938 711 123 (Mr Tiến) + Website: https://mercedesvn.vn

The average compensation cost for each accident can be up to tens of millions of VND. For example: A business with a serious accident may have to spend 50-100 million VND on medical expenses, compensation and wages for workers during the break. 💸Production interruption: When an accident occurs, factories often have to stop production to investigate the cause and take remedial measures, causing loss of productivity. For example: A manufacturing business that is shut down for 2 days can lose tens to hundreds of millions of VND in revenue, depending on its scale. Damage to reputation and loss of trust from employees: Workplace accidents often reduce employee trust and loyalty to the company, leading to increased turnover and reduced productivity. Investing in safety equipment is not only a way to protect employees but also a long-term financial investment for businesses. In Vietnam, where industries are developing rapidly, ensuring occupational safety is essential to minimize risks, save costs and increase labor productivity. about: INDOCHINA LEGAL is a multi-cultural law firm, founded in 2007 by Eric Le Dréau and Nguyen Quoc Tuan. The firm operates from Vietnam through its local and foreign professionals in its Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi offices and well-established network of correspondents in the Indochina Region. Our services combine strong legal expertise on and culturally-sensitive approach to substantive, regulatory and procedural issues to ensure that commercial transactions and business relationships develop smoothly and effectively. Indochina Legal advises its clients on all legal aspects of investing and doing business in Vietnam, including: - Corporate and commercial law. - Mergers and acquisitions. - Tax planning and advice. - Banking and project finance. - Corporate finance. - Land transactions and property development. Over the years, the Firm has developed a diversified foreign client base both local and foreign, from start up to listed multinational and Global 1000 companies across Europe, North America and Asia in a wide spectrum of industries. In order to help you to invest in Vietnam, we developed a network of contacts with ministries and other officials. Our law firm is correspondent in Vietnam of CMS Bureau Francis Lefebvre (France) and is the member for Vietnam of Legalink, an international network of independent law firms.

about: Industrialization and urbanization intensify environmental health risks and pollution, especially in developing countries. We know that humans have dramatic cardiovascular effects from exposure to dirty air, high blood pressure in particular. And we know that babies can be harmed by pollution both before and after birth. Diapers are a part of every moment of our baby’s life for a long while. They are intimately connected to our little one’s body and directly on his or her skin. The natural diapers can give our babies a great fit, which will protect their bum. And, by using nonwoven natural materials to make baby diapers that are biodegradable, non-toxic to the environment and mainly include the natural substances only. This will contribute to reducing the pollution up to some level. Babies Trading and Investment .,JSC was founded on the idea to develop, provide natural diapers that are completely safe for not only our babies, but the environment as well. Our natural diapers may cost even twice as much as the leading disposable diapers. But when you choose our natural diapers, you are choosing a diaper that is kinder and gentler both to our environment and to your baby’s sensitive skin.

MBC objectives involves bringing Malaysians together from diverse businesses to promote and enhance inter-personal and professional development whilst engaging in community service initiatives. With co-operations and collaborations with many other associations across the country, MBC has achieved the highest accreditation and recognition through organizing various events on business networking and forums, charities, and sports. MBC is an excellent platform and environment for its members to meet and exchange ideas, information, and expertise.

updates.text: Over the weekend, I had the honour of celebrating Merdeka with the Malaysia Business Chamber Vietnam - MBC , and for the first time, I had the privilege of co-presenting the programme. This year Malaysia marks 68 years of independence, while Vietnam celebrates 80 years. Being a part of these concurrent milestones made me reflect on the two heritages I am fortunate to carry: being a child of both Malaysia and Vietnam - as part of what some might call the “hybrid generation”. What then is the advantage of being a hybrid? No, not the better fuel economy or reduced emissions (😊). As a generation, we inherit Malaysia’s spirit of unity in diversity and Vietnam’s resilience and drive. We are given our roots to remind us of where we come from, but growing up in this duality opens routes for the generations that follow. During the celebration, a conversation with a fellow business associate also stayed with me. He observed that MBC events are attended out of pride, not obligation. It was a simple observation, but it speaks volumes about the enduring spirit of Malaysia and the community that MBC has built over 25 years in Vietnam. Being part of the hybrid generation is a privilege, and the fun part is figuring out how to use it to connect people across these two communities. #Merdeka #MalaysiaDay

updates.text: 🌏 Honored to attend the ASEAN Malaysian Business Chambers Summit 2025 in Vientiane, Laos – a valuable platform to strengthen collaboration and enhance connectivity across ASEAN. It was an inspiring day of dialogue, knowledge sharing, and networking with business leaders, diplomats, and chamber representatives from across the region. A highlight was the site visit to the Vientiane Logistics Park, where we saw first-hand how a modern dry port operates. It was truly informative to understand the critical role logistics and connectivity play in driving regional trade and investment. I was especially glad to join with my colleagues from the Malaysia Business Chamber Vietnam - MBC as part of our delegation, and to connect with our peers from the wider ASEAN business community. A big thank you to Chee Seng TEE , President of Malaysia Business Chamber Lao PDR, the organizers and partners for making this summit possible. Looking forward to building on these connections and creating more opportunities for businesses and communities across ASEAN. 🤝 #ASEAN #BusinessNetworking #MBCV #RegionalConnectivity #Logistics #AMBCS2025 Angus L. Lok Kah Seng Wilson Lee Si Heng Yu Gabrielle Swi Min Loo Tay Keng Chong ANG TM

Trong khi người dùng và cả ngân hàng phải gánh một khoản chi phí lớn hàng tháng cho các tin nhắn chuyển mã OTP, họ vẫn đang đối mặt với hàng loạt nguy cơ phổ biến như lừa đảo giả mạo, đánh cắp SIM, chặn tin nhắn… Ngoài ra, các chuyên gia nhận định OTP dưới hình thức nào cũng để lại rủi ro trước các biện pháp tấn công lừa đảo và mã độc ngày càng gia tăng. Theo Báo cáo Trải nghiệm Xác thực Ứng dụng Ngân hàng Việt Nam 2025 thực hiện bởi VinCSS, chỉ 15,7% người dùng tin rằng SMS OTP thực sự an toàn và người dùng đang có xu hướng chuyển dịch mạnh mẽ từ các phương thức xác thực truyền thống như mật khẩu, các hình thức OTP sang các phương thức xác thực hiện đại hơn như sinh trắc học, passkey, chữ ký số. Xem báo cáo chi tiết tại: 👉 https://lnkd.in/gufJ2GsT __ SMS OTP, one of the most widely used banking authentication methods, is now being left behind by users. While both users and banks continue to bear significant monthly costs for OTP text messages, they still face numerous threats such as phishing scams, SIM swapping, and message interception. Experts also point out that OTP—regardless of the form—still carries significant risks against today’s widespread phishing and malware attacks. According to the Viet Nam Banking App Authentication Experience Report 2025 by VinCSS, only 15.7% of users believe SMS OTP is truly secure, and there is a strong shift away from traditional methods like passwords and OTPs towards more modern authentication methods such as biometrics, passkeys, and digital signatures. Full report: 👉 https://lnkd.in/gD_eD2vB

updates.text: Chỉ trong 01 ngày ra mắt, báo cáo đầu tiên tại Việt Nam về trải nghiệm xác thực trên các ứng dụng ngân hàng thực hiện bởi VinCSS đã thu về gần 1000 lượt tìm đọc. Hàng loạt báo chí trong nước và quốc tế đang trích dẫn các số liệu từ báo cáo, trả lời cho các câu hỏi rất được quan tâm hiện nay: ❓ Người dùng lo lắng gì nhất khi xác thực? ❓ Ngân hàng nào đang được đánh giá cao/thấp nhất? ❓ Tệp người dùng nào sẽ thay đổi cuộc chơi? 📊 Xem báo cáo chi tiết tại: https://lnkd.in/gufJ2GsT __ Within just one day of its release, the first-ever report in Vietnam on user authentication experiences in banking apps, conducted by VinCSS, has attracted roughly 1,000 reads. Numerous domestic and international media outlets are citing data from the report to help answer some of today’s most pressing questions: ❓ What are users most concerned about when authenticating? ❓ Which banks are rated highest, and lowest? ❓ Which user segments could reshape the game? 📥 Read the full report at: https://lnkd.in/gD_eD2vB

updates.text: BÁO CÁO ĐẦU TIÊN TẠI VIỆT NAM VỀ TRẢI NGHIỆM XÁC THỰC TRÊN ỨNG DỤNG NGÂN HÀNG 🔹 2022, các ứng dụng ngân hàng tại Việt Nam đã đạt gần 18 triệu lượt tải. 🔹 2023, hơn 30% dân số Việt Nam sử dụng các ứng dụng ngân hàng, đứng thứ hai toàn thế giới chỉ sau Trung Quốc. 🔹 Xu hướng không dùng tiền mặt đang được Chính phủ thúc đẩy mạnh mẽ càng khiến các ứng dụng này mở rộng bề mặt tiếp xúc với người dùng. Nhưng bề mặt tiếp xúc luôn tỷ lệ thuận với bề mặt tấn công. Ngày càng nhiều sự cố bảo mật nghiêm trọng trong và ngoài lĩnh vực ngân hàng - hầu hết đều khởi phát từ lỗ hổng ở khâu xác thực - đã dấy lên nhiều lo ngại cho cả người dùng và nhà cung cấp dịch vụ. Đối với các ứng dụng ngân hàng, xác thực là điểm chạm đầu tiên và cũng là cửa ngõ trực tiếp dẫn đến tài sản số quý giá nhất của người dùng: tiền bạc. ❓ Vậy người dùng Việt Nam đang cảm thấy thế nào mỗi lần xác thực trên các ứng dụng ngân hàng? Hàng ngàn người dùng khắp cả nước đã chung tay làm nên báo cáo này, trả lời các câu hỏi: ▪️ Người dùng thực sự cảm thấy thế nào trong quá trình xác thực? ▪️ Đâu là yếu tố ảnh hưởng lớn nhất đến đánh giá của người dùng? ▪️ Những ngân hàng nào đang được người dùng đánh giá là cao nhất/thấp nhất về trải nghiệm xác thực? ▪️ Nhóm khách hàng nào là khó tính và đáng chinh phục nhất? Chi tiết báo cáo tại phần bình luận: __ VIET NAM'S FIRST REPORT ON BANKING APP AUTHENTICATION EXPERIENCE 🔹 In 2022, banking applications in Viet Nam recorded nearly 18 million downloads. 🔹 By 2023, more than 30% of the Vietnamese population were using banking apps, ranking second worldwide, just after China. 🔹 With the Government strongly promoting the cashless payment trend, these applications have rapidly expanded their user interaction surface. However, a broader interaction surface also means a broader attack surface. An increasing number of severe security incidents, both within and beyond the banking sector, most originating from vulnerabilities in the authentication stage, have raised serious concerns for both users and service providers. For banking applications, authentication is not only the very first touchpoint, but also the direct gateway to users’ most valuable digital assets: their money. ❓ So how do Vietnamese users actually feel each time they authenticate on banking apps? Thousands of users nationwide contributed to this report, helping to answer key questions: ▪️ How do users perceive and feel during the authentication process? ▪️ What factors most significantly influence user satisfaction ratings? ▪️ Which banks receive the highest and lowest evaluations from users regarding authentication experience? ▪️ Which customer segments are the most demanding and therefore the most valuable to capture? Full report available in the comments, in both English and Vietnamese.
updates.text_html:
BÁO CÁO ĐẦU TIÊN TẠI VIỆT NAM VỀ TRẢI NGHIỆM XÁC THỰC TRÊN ỨNG DỤNG NGÂN HÀNG

🔹 2022, các ứng dụng ngân hàng tại Việt Nam đã đạt gần 18 triệu lượt tải. 
🔹 2023, hơn 30% dân số Việt Nam sử dụng các ứng dụng ngân hàng, đứng thứ hai toàn thế giới chỉ sau Trung Quốc. 
🔹 Xu hướng không dùng tiền mặt đang được Chính phủ thúc đẩy mạnh mẽ càng khiến các ứng dụng này mở rộng bề mặt tiếp xúc với người dùng.

Nhưng bề mặt tiếp xúc luôn tỷ lệ thuận với bề mặt tấn công. Ngày càng nhiều sự cố bảo mật nghiêm trọng trong và ngoài lĩnh vực ngân hàng - hầu hết đều khởi phát từ lỗ hổng ở khâu xác thực - đã dấy lên nhiều lo ngại cho cả người dùng và nhà cung cấp dịch vụ. 

Đối với các ứng dụng ngân hàng, xác thực là điểm chạm đầu tiên và cũng là cửa ngõ trực tiếp dẫn đến tài sản số quý giá nhất của người dùng: tiền bạc. 

❓ Vậy người dùng Việt Nam đang cảm thấy thế nào mỗi lần xác thực trên các ứng dụng ngân hàng?

Hàng ngàn người dùng khắp cả nước đã chung tay làm nên báo cáo này, trả lời các câu hỏi:
▪️ Người dùng thực sự cảm thấy thế nào trong quá trình xác thực?
▪️ Đâu là yếu tố ảnh hưởng lớn nhất đến đánh giá của người dùng?
▪️ Những ngân hàng nào đang được người dùng đánh giá là cao nhất/thấp nhất về trải nghiệm xác thực?
▪️ Nhóm khách hàng nào là khó tính và đáng chinh phục nhất?

Chi tiết báo cáo tại phần bình luận:
__
VIET NAM'S FIRST REPORT ON BANKING APP AUTHENTICATION EXPERIENCE

🔹 In 2022, banking applications in Viet Nam recorded nearly 18 million downloads.
🔹 By 2023, more than 30% of the Vietnamese population were using banking apps,  ranking second worldwide, just after China.
🔹 With the Government strongly promoting the cashless payment trend, these applications have rapidly expanded their user interaction surface.

However, a broader interaction surface also means a broader attack surface. An increasing number of severe security incidents, both within and beyond the banking sector, most originating from vulnerabilities in the authentication stage, have raised serious concerns for both users and service providers.

For banking applications, authentication is not only the very first touchpoint, but also the direct gateway to users’ most valuable digital assets: their money.

❓ So how do Vietnamese users actually feel each time they authenticate on banking apps?

Thousands of users nationwide contributed to this report, helping to answer key questions:
▪️ How do users perceive and feel during the authentication process?
▪️ What factors most significantly influence user satisfaction ratings?
▪️ Which banks receive the highest and lowest evaluations from users regarding authentication experience?
▪️ Which customer segments are the most demanding and therefore the most valuable to capture?

Full report available in the comments, in both English and Vietnamese.

updates.text: ZEROTRUST, MAKE IN VIETNAM! VinCSS is honored to participate in the exhibition “80 Years of Independence – Freedom – Happiness” held at the Vietnam National Exhibition Center. We are proud to have contributed to the development of our nation. At this event, VinCSS also introduces for the first time its Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solution – a strategic product that I have nurtured for nearly 10 years. ZTNA is the result of combining FIDO/FDO technologies with the extensive cybersecurity expertise of the VinCSS team. We are also introducing, for the first time, post-quantum cryptography techniques in this solution. P/S: To constantly remind myself of the goal of creating this Zero Trust solution, I painted the word ZEROTRUST on the front right door of my VF9 car (as well as on many of my previous cars). Every time I hop on, I see it. You can also see the entire mission that VinCSS has set forth boldly painted on the sides of this striking VF9 as it drives across the city. #vincss #ztna #zerotrust #fido2 #fdo #fidoalliance #a80
