updates.text: #ESGTakashimaya | Books Build Futures – Trang Sách Mở Lối Tương Lai 🌱 As part of our internal ESG Project, Takashimaya Vietnam recently launched Books Build Futures – an employee-led initiative aimed at promoting sustainability through knowledge sharing. In just one month, our internal campaign has collected over 200 books thanks to the contributions of our team members. These donated books will soon find their way to new readers through the Nuôi Em Organization – supporting the creation of “Tủ sách Nuôi Em” (Nuôi Em Book Corners) for children in remote highland areas across Vietnam. This not only extends the life of each book but also brings learning opportunities to communities that need them most. This initiative reflects our company’s ongoing commitment to the SDGs, especially SDG4 – Quality Education, SGD12 – Responsible Consumption & Production, SDG10 – Reduced Inequalities. Books Build Futures is just one step in our broader ESG journey, it is what we hope will continue to grow through meaningful participation and a shared sense of purpose. By extending the life of book, we take another step toward a more inclusive and sustainable future starting right in our workplace. This is not the final chapter – so stay tuned. -- Trong tháng 6 vừa rồi, Takashimaya Vietnam đã khởi động chương trình Trang Sách Mở Lối Tương Lai - Books Build Futures, một chiến dịch nhằm thúc đẩy phát triển bền vững thông qua việc chia sẻ tri thức. Chỉ trong vòng một tháng, chiến dịch đã thu về được hơn 200 quyển sách nhờ vào sự đóng góp nhiệt tình từ các thành viên trong công ty. Những quyển sách được tặng sẽ sớm được thông qua Tổ chức Nuôi Em, góp phần xây dựng các “Tủ sách Nuôi Em” dành cho trẻ em ở các vùng cao, vùng sâu vùng xa trên khắp Việt Nam. Trang Sách Mở Lối Tương Lai sẽ không chỉ giúp kéo dài vòng đời của mỗi quyển sách mà còn mang lại cơ hội học tập cho những trẻ em ở vùng cao. Chiến dịch thể hiện cam kết của Takashimaya Vietnam với các Mục tiêu Phát triển Bền vững, đặc biệt là SDG4 – Giáo dục có chất lượng, SDG12 – Tiêu thụ và sản xuất có trách nhiệm, SDG10 – Giảm bất bình đẳng. Trang Sách Mở Lối Tương Lai chỉ là một trong những bước khởi đầu trong hành trình ESG của Takashimaya Vietnam – một hành trình mà chúng tôi hy vọng sẽ tiếp tục phát triển nhờ vào sự tham gia tích cực và tinh thần đồng hành vì mục tiêu chung. Việc kéo dài vòng đời của những quyển sách chính là một hành động nhỏ nhưng ý nghĩa, hướng đến một tương lai bền vững bắt đầu ngay từ chính môi trường làm việc của chúng ta. #TakashimayaVietnam #SustainabilityInAction #ESG #BooksBuildFutures #SDGs #Sustainability

Binhminhpat Packaging Company Ltd.

Dear Valued Customers!

Binh Minh PAT packaging Company, we are one of the biggest printing and packaging manufacturers, located in Ho Chi Minh city, near the Ho Chi Minh port in Vietnam.

With the co-operation, development and production together, we have many subsidiaries for supplying packagings.

We are specialized in producing carton boxes, paper box, Paper display Shelves,stickers, decal labels, prochures catalogues, flexible films, Print Invoice, Print Exclusive Schedule and bags, mono films, paper boxes, paper labels for many fields such as foods, seafoods, pharmaceuticals, chemicals products and so on.

Our packaging products have been known to the market for over 10 years and are constantly improving through using Modern Equipment Technology in order to satisfy fully the accuracy and time increasing demand of both domestic and international market.

Our advanced technologies imported from Japan, EU included gravure, offset and flexo printings, Printing Offset: large size: 1.1 (m) x 1.6 (m) . With the experiences in packaging for more than 10 years, we have exported products to USA, Hollands, Japan and so on with the manpower more than 500 persons in company.

We have experiences in management of technology human and based on having ability of high technology, our production capacities are achieved by 100 million sqm/year for flexible packaging, by 20 million meters/year for sticker label, by 15 million sqm/year for corrugated box, by 55 million sqm/year for carton box and paper label.

With the commitment to customers, Binh Minh PAT . CO. LTD would like to offer the reasonable price, quick production and good service. We would like to co-operate and hope to have profitable mutually. All customers will be given a warm welcome when contacting us. Please visit our website: www.binhminhpackaging.vn for more information.

updates.text: Thư ngỏ: Bạn là một người trẻ năng động có ước mơ đóng góp cho ngành nông nghiệp, bằng tri thức và kỹ năng của bản thân trong các lĩnh vực AI, Blockchain, tự động hóa, cà phê, v.vv... để giải quyết các bài toán lớn như biến đổi khí hậu, chuỗi cung ứng, truy xuất nguồn gốc, hợp đồng thông minh (Smart contract) v.vv... Vậy Dự án OrgaBlock là cơ hội hiếm có trong ngành nông nghiệp để bạn tỏa sáng và cống hiến những giá trị của bản thân. Sứ mệnh: - Giúp giải quyết các vấn đề như: truy xuất nguồn gốc, kiểm chứng nguồn nông sản hữu cơ cho ngành nông nghiệp Việt Nam, giúp 1 triệu đối tác sản xuất và tiêu thụ trong chuỗi cung ứng cà phê gắn kết bền vững hơn, chặt chẽ hơn, tiết kiệm hơn và giá trị hơn. - Ứng dụng công nghệ blockchain để tạo ra sản phẩm tiền mã hóa cho ngành nông nghiệp, xác thực tự động các hợp đồng thông minh, dự báo thời tiết và truy xuất nguồn gốc v.vv - Xây dựng đội nhóm "Think globally, act locally". Tham gia dự án, bạn sẽ nhận được các quyền lợi sau: - Cơ hội sử dụng bộ siêu ứng dụng hàng đầu thế giới để biến ước mơ của bạn thành hiện thực sớm nhất nhanh nhất có thể, các công cụ có thể kể đến là Microsoft Dynamics 365, Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, các ứng dụng blockchain tiên tiến. - Xây dựng đội nhóm của chính mình với văn hóa trao quyền năng động, cởi mở và sẵn sàng kiến tạo tương lai của chính mình. - Gói cổ phần dành cho nhóm sáng lập dự án. - Và nhiều quyền lợi để phát triển bản thân khác nữa ... Còn chần chờ gì nữa ??? Nếu bạn nhận thấy bản thân phù hợp với dự án, vậy đừng bỏ lỡ cơ hội, hãy gửi hồ sơ năng lực, nhận lịch phỏng vấn để có cơ hội tham gia dự án nhé. #Orgablock

updates.text: GM Builders, What a wild two weeks! 🎉 We've been on a whirlwind tour, connecting with builders, partners, and friends at GM Vietnam and Conviction. We're still buzzing from the energy! We kicked things off in Hanoi with three incredible events: - Lisk Vietnam BUIDL-athon: We saw amazing blockchain solutions for Vietnam, from decentralized finance to creative IP projects. Big congrats to all the winners! - The StoryVerse: A fantastic evening celebrating decentralized storytelling and IP with @StoryEcosystem and @StoryVietnam. - Web3 Builders' Brunch: We dived deep into the future of Web3 and AI with insights from @Avalanche_vn and @chainlink. Then we headed back to Saigon for more! - Web3 Builders' Drinks: Web Meets AI Saigon: A packed evening exploring the roles of AI in Web3 with a panel featuring Superteam Vietnam and Krystal. - Paddle Tap #1: Builders' Meetup @Conviction: We wrapped up our event series with a high-energy pickleball match, proving that our community can build and compete with the best of them! A huge thank you to everyone who joined us and made these events so special. The spirit of Viet builders is stronger than ever! A video summary of our Hanoi events and presence is uploaded here: https://lnkd.in/gy9kfe-B . Check out the full album of photos in the comments below. 👇

updates.text: Recap (3/4): "Data x AI in Web3" – Fueling the Future at #Web3BuildersSummit 2025, Da Nang! A deep dive into the critical synergy between data & AI in the decentralized world! Grateful to moderator Long Pham ( sqrDAO sqrFUND), who is also a valued Swiss EP's EIR. Leo's dedication to building Da Nang's Web3 ecosystem, connecting global builders, and his exceptional capacity-building work with our Partner Organization, Decentralab, has been truly impactful. Great insights from panelists Kha Nguyen ( Birdeye.so ), Johnson Lai ( Chromia ), Tu Chu ( Oraichain Labs ), and Tung Le ( Decentralab Pte. Ltd / Copin.io ). Core insights on data's role in powering Web3 AI: - The Future: High Expectations, Rapid Evolution Kha: AI will be "very, very powerful," though long-term predictions are tough in this fast-paced field. Johnson: The future hinges on "verifiability, traceability, and ethics" in data. Quality over quantity is paramount. Tu Chu: AI is an "undeniable tier" making data accessible & lowering Web3's complexity barrier. - Data as the "New Oil" and Decentralized Marketplaces Kha: Birdeye processes raw on-chain data into reliable "fuel" (structured, low-latency feeds) for AI engines. Johnson: Raw data gains value through aggregation and packaging. Think projects tracking real-world events. Tung Le: Web3 offers chances to turn raw data into actionable insights or new models like data DAOs, beyond just "selling APIs." - AI: From Raw Data to Actionable Intelligence Kha: Birdeye abstracts on-chain complexity, making data like balances & transaction history usable. Tu Chu: AI's role is to "remove all the noise" from vast on-chain data, extracting value. High-quality, curated datasets are crucial to avoid AI "hallucinations." Tung Le: AI can index and structure complex on-chain data, aiding user understanding & powering tools like Copin for trade analysis/copy-trading. - Privacy, Security and Ethics – A Core Concern Johnson: Verifiability, traceability and ethics are vital. Tu Chu: Avoiding AI bias and ensuring data quality are key ethical considerations. Moderator Leo reinforced industry concern for trust and ethical AI. - High-Quality, Structured Data is Non-Negotiable The panel universally agreed: AI effectiveness = data quality. Johnson: "You can't build a good AI system without proper quality data. It's not about amount, it's quality." Future Opportunities: - Hyper-personalized Web3 experiences. - Advanced AI-powered blockchain intelligence (fraud detection, risk management). - Decentralized data marketplaces with verifiable quality. - AI decision support for DAOs and individuals. - AI lowering Web3 adoption barriers. Data is AI's lifeblood. As on-chain data explodes, sophisticated AI is crucial. The future is a smarter, data-driven decentralized web, demanding focus on data quality, robust infrastructure, ethics, and user-centric design. #Web3 #AI #Data #Blockchain #VietnamTech #DaNangInnovation #W3BDN #SwissEP #TechForGood

updates.text: GM Builders, As teased during our Web3 Builders' Summit and Web3 Builders' Dinner: LFBUIDL Da Nang, we are excited to officially announce Lisk Vietnam BUIDL-athon, an 8-week program for Vietnam-focused builders and developers. What does it entail, and what's in it for you? 🧵👇 Co-hosted by @LiskHQ and @vbi_academy, this builder-centric hackathon and training extravaganza promises to transform developers and entrepreneurs across Vietnam. Catch you in Hanoi—and fingers crossed, Bali—this August! LFBUIDL

updates.text: 🚀 WEB3 BUILDERS’ SUMMIT 2025: THE RISE OF AI The Web3 Builders’ Summit 2025, hosted by sqrDAO , SQRFUND, Da Nang DSAC , Decentralab Pte. Ltd , and backed by key partners, made a powerful splash in the #Web3 , #Blockchain , and #AI communities. The event featured: 🔺30+ leading experts 🔺15+ deep-dive sessions 🔺200+ passionate participants 🔺8 innovative startup showcases 🧠The summit, themed 💢The Rise of AI💢, examined the integration of AI and Blockchain, highlighting its potential to transform key industries such as finance and supply chain management through innovative advancements. 📣 Mr. Le Son Phong, Deputy Director of Da Nang’s Department of Science and Technology, opened the summit by highlighting the city’s commitment to innovation and its ambition to become a transparent, collaborative hub for emerging technologies. 🔍 Morning Highlights: Attendees engaged in four expert-led panel discussions featuring Vietnam’s leading Web3 innovators: ✨The State of Web3 & AI, moderated by Ms Jade Hoang from Decentralab Pte. Ltd ✨Web3’s Agentic Ai Evolution, moderated by Mr. Kevin Tran from GenezizDAO ✨Data x Ai in Web3, moderated by Mr. Long Pham from sqrDAO ✨Web3 & Ai in Danang & Vietnam, moderated by Mr. Hai Dang Ngoc from Da Nang Software Association 💼 Afternoon Highlights: The Blockchain x AI Demo Day spotlighted #8 pioneering startups, each showcasing their tech solutions to a crowd of potential investors, collaborators, and ecosystem partners. The program also included two keynote addresses: 🔹Powering Web3 Startups and Businesses in High-Growth Market by Gideon Greaves - Head of Global Apps at Lisk 🔹Strategic Directions and Solutions for Building the Semiconductor and Ai Ecosystem in Da Nang by Mr. Phuc Le , Director of the Da Nang Semiconductor & AI Center ( Da Nang DSAC ) 💡 The summit marked a key step in connecting Da Nang’s Web3 ecosystem with global trends, opening doors to international partnerships, investment, and next-gen talent development. More than just a meetup, Web3 Builders’ Summit 2025 served as a platform for strategic dialogue and practical exploration, spotlighting the rise of Agentic AI, real-world use cases, and opportunities to advance the Web3 x AI ecosystem in Da Nang and beyond. #SwissEP #SwissEPVietnam #Web3BuildersSummit #Blockchain #Ai #Web3 #Danang ----- Swiss EP is powered by SECO Economic Cooperation and Development and implemented by Swisscontact and J.E. updates.text: Da Nang’s momentum is real — and builders are shaping the future. This morning, I had chance to sit down with Eli David Rokah , CEO of StartupBlink , and Hub Langstaff , Country Director of Swiss EP Vietnam - Swiss Entrepreneurship Program , to explore how Da Nang can climb higher on the global innovation map. Eli shared key insights: “Da Nang doesn’t need to be everything — it needs to find its strong vertical and own it.” Using StartupBlink’s data-driven methodology, he highlighted how global rankings can reflect and reinforce local progress. He also urged the city to create a welcoming environment for builders in expats and digital nomads community here to set up business in Da Nang. The ripple effects? - More startups and registered companies - More jobs and tax contributions - A stronger “business score” and upward movement in global rankings This couldn’t be more timely. Tomorrow, we kick off Web3 Builders’ Summit 2025 – The Rise of AI (June 3, Furama Resort), right here in Da Nang — fresh on the heels of DAVAS 2025 (🔗 davas.vc ). Thanks our friends and partners Long Pham sqrDAO , Jade Hoang , Tung Le Decentralab Pte. Ltd , Trung Hieu Bui Adele Doan Superteam Vietnam , Stan Nguyen Aptos Labs , Kim Trong Kyber Network and many more to make it happen in Da Nang. I also be on a panel discussion with: - Mr. Phuc Le (CEO Da Nang Semiconductor & AI Center ) – driving semiconductor & AI development in Da Nang - Mr. Cuong Nguyen Manh ( Sovico Group ) – deep tech & AI infrastructure visionary - innovation in corporate. - Mr. Hai Dang Ngoc (Da Nang Software Association - DSA) – a local champion behind DevDay Da Nang 2025 , the annual dev event that just celebrated its 10th edition in March 2025! With over 50,000 software engineers, the software industry remains a major pillar of Da Nang’s digital economy. I’ll share how Swiss EP Vietnam’s mission aligns with Da Nang’s growth: By empowering incubators, startup programs, and emerging verticals like Web3 x AI, CBE, we’re building the foundation for more resilient, connected, and global-ready startups. We’ll dive into: - How Da Nang can become a regional hub for emerging technologies (AI, blockchain) - Building sustainable ecosystems through local–expat collaboration - What’s working—and what’s still missing—in Da Nang’s startup support systems Join us and 300+ builders, founders, and tech enthusiasts at the summit! Expect keynotes, hands-on demos, startup showcases, and one epic Web3 Builders' Dinner. 🎟️ Info + tickets: June 3rd https://lnkd.in/g3uqrbTj June 4th https://supervietnam.com/ June 5th https://solanasummit.org/ Let’s #BUIDL Da Nang together — stronger, smarter, and more global. #Web3BuildersSummit #SwissEPVietnam #DaNang #Web3 #AI #StartupEcosystem #DEVDAY #StartupBlink #DigitalEconomy #VietnamTech #InnovationEconomy #DAVAS #BuildersUnite #SolanaSummitAPAC #SuperVietnam #SrqDAO #DSAC #SwissEP #Decentralab #W3BDN
